This paper suggests an efficient design of Wireless Power Transfer System (WPTS) for battery charging. The paper discusses the fundamentals of WTP and battery charging system, the mathematical model and design of the coil in ANSYS MAXWELL software for efficient power transfer. MATLAB simulation of EV with battery charging using WTPS has been studied and the results are presented.

articleTitle: Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy with Ground-Truth Segmentation using Fundus Image
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Automated analysis of lesions in retinal images could help in the early diagnosis and screening of Diabetic Retinopathy (DR), a common condition. This work presents reliable and operationally effective methods for locating distinct characteristics and lesions in a fundus retinal picture. Geometric characteristics and relationships were utilized to discriminate apart elements that have similar intensity characteristics. The retina was properly imaged and evaluated by trained personnel. The regularity of exams was determined by the intensity of diabetic retinopathy, which in turn affects the speed of advancement. Computer-assisted surveillance has become required due to a serious shortage of skilled monitors. Researchers suggest a new requirement for detecting the optical disc, in which they first recognize the major blood vessels and utilize their crossing to determine the approximate area of the optic disc. Color characteristics are used to better localize the image. Researchers also demonstrated that several of the characteristics, such as blood vessels, exudates, microaneurysms, and hemorrhages, could be recognized rather precisely with the use of various morphological techniques. Rigorous testing of the method on a dataset of 516 images to varying comparison, illumination, and ailment phases yielded a 97.1 percent success rate for optic disc navigation, 95.7 percent, and 94.2 percent sensitivity and specificity for exudate diagnosis, and 95.1 percent and 90.5 percent sensitivity and specificity for microaneurysm/hemorrhage diagnosis. These operate similarly to current systems and indicate that these technologies will be deployed shortly.

articleTitle: Creating Models for 3D printing Using Kinect based Scanners
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This work intends to demonstrate a simple method for creating models suitable for 3D printing or other digital manufacturing equipment using a Kinect-based scanner. The output of Kinect-based scanners is a depth map, and they often need complex computer operations to prepare them for digital production. For professional and recreational use alike, new depth cameras that have hit the market in recent years have opened up a wealth of exciting new possibilities for creatives. The Microsoft Kinect sensor, which was initially included with the Xbox 360 video game system, serves as an example of such a camera. In this article, a system is given that makes use of this device to build a 3D reconstruction of an interior environment that is as realistic as feasible. This article explains the use of an RGB-D camera to create a 3D model of an interior scene (Microsoft Kinect V2.0). Since the release of the Microsoft Kinect sensor, 3D mapping and localization have been an increasingly popular study area.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Conventional and Adavanced Controllers for Level Control of Coupled Tank Process
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In many chemical and food processing industries, liquid level control and flow control between tanks plays a major role. This paper deals with mathematical modelling and level control of coupled tank process with SISO configuration. Conventional and advanced controllers like PI, fuzzy, neuro and neuro-fuzzy are designed and simulated for this system using MATLAB/Simulink. Simulation results are presented and compared. Servo response with PI controller is oscillatory, whereas with advanced controllers is smooth. It is observed from the results that the designed fuzzy controller is capable of faster setpoint tracking than other controllers for this nonlinear system.

articleTitle: Music Recommendation based on Facial Expression using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Music is a fantastic way for people to express themselves as well as a good source of enjoyment for music fans and listeners. Furthermore, relaxing music is an effective technique for evoking strong emotions and sending a quiet message. With technological advancements, the number of artists, their music, and music listeners is growing, which brings up the issue of manually exploring and picking music. This study offers a system that uses facial expressions at real time of a user to assess the user’s mood (Emotion detection Model), output of which is then combined with mapped music from the music dataset to create a user-specific music playlist (music recommendation model). Convolutional neural network is used to classify the users emotions in 7 different categories with an accuracy rate of 94 percent, thus satisfying the actual aim of the study.

articleTitle: Arrhythmia Detection and ECG Signal Analysis using Digital Filtering Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The non-linearity in ECG signals, as well as the wide variance in ECG morphologies among individuals, are the fundamental problems with automated ECG analysis. Background disturbances, like electrode motion artefact and electromyogram-induced noise, taint ECG signals in the majority of cases, adding to the difficulties of automatic ECG pattern detection. System design is employed to analyze arrhythmia detection and ECG signals in the suggested technique. To filter away the baseline wander noise included in the input ECG signal to the network, this technology uses a high pass least-square linear phase FIR filtering approach. To extract the decreased significant features from the input ECG signal, the DWT is used as a feature extraction tool. To categorize the input ECG signal, the design employs a SVM classifier. This SVM classifies the final output as normal ECG signal and abnormal ECG signal, which composes of atrial contraction, atrial relaxation, ventricular contraction, and ventricular repolarization. On a Xilinx Spartan 6 FPGA board, the system has been developed. A simulation of the system has been carried out. The Xilinx System Generator blocks from the MATLAB program are employed to analyze ECG signals.

articleTitle: A Christ Cross Slotted Antenna for 5G mm Waves Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A miniaturized novel Christ Cross slotted antenna for 5G mm wave wireless communications is presented in this research paper. This compact, wideband antenna was created on a low-cost flame retardant (FR-4) with a dielectric permittivity (ε<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf>) of 4.4, a tan δ value of 0.02, and a thickness (h) of 0.8mm. The calculated dimensions of an antenna are 7 x 7 x 0.8 mm3. It comprises copper radiating patch and a full ground plane. The antenna is made up of Christ cross slot in the middle of the patch that has been tuned for wideband performance. The proposed antenna is excited through the quarter-wave transformer-supported insert feed. The computed impedance bandwidth covers the frequency range of 26.7 to 29.2 GHz at <-10 dB. At 27.94 GHz, the antenna presented in the research has a low reflection coefficient (Γ) of -24.13 dB, total gain (G) of 6.4 dB, and a radiation efficiency of 82%, 85% at 28 GHz and 31 GHz frequencies respectively. The presented antenna is simulated using Ansys HFSS.

articleTitle: Mitotic Instance Detection in Stain Normalized Histopathological Images using Faster R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Our method aims to detect and identify the possibility of malignancy based on abnormal mitotic cell division using Artificial Intelligence. In tumour grading, the mitotic activity index is an important prognostic factor. The standard approach entails expert pathologists manually examining H&E stained histopathological sections on glass slides under a microscope, which is time-consuming and error-prone, thereby a need for automation. Due to the lack of pixel-level annotations, the presence of mitotic nuclei in numerous morphological configurations, their sparse representation, and their strong similarity to other cellular and nuclear bodies, automated mitotic nuclei recognition faces many obstacles. Hence, an efficient and accurate automated approach is necessary for early prognosis. This early detection helps the pathologists to find the mitotic cells considerably faster. This research work has used various backbone architectures of the Faster R-CNN model to classify the mitotic nuclei and compare their performance.

articleTitle: Real Time Human Activity Recognition from Accelerometer Data using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The study of human regular tasks have become more prevalent and accessible as a result of the widespread use of different sensors integrated into mobile devices. This issue now exists in different vast real-world area applications some examples are “healthcare monitoring, fitness tracking, and user-adaptive systems”. Where a generic model capable of recognizing an arbitrary user’s activity in real-time is necessary. This paper presents a user-independent deep learning technique for digital human activity categorization. The proposed research study advocates the utilization of CNN in combination with basic statistical characteristics to maintain the information regarding the global shape of different time series for performing a local feature extraction. This research study also focuses on how the duration of a time series affects recognition accuracy ans restricting it to a single second to allow time series analysis for performing activity classification.

articleTitle: Dynamic EV Charging by Wireless Power Transfer
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: With the tremendous increase in fuel price and alarming increase in environmental pollution, it is high time to shift towards greener energy sources for mobility. This has resulted in the increase in electric vehicle usage considering that they are much more ecofriendly and technologically advanced. Surveys prove a lot of people are hesitant towards buying e-vehicles due to inadequate charging stations and charging measures. The time consumed to charge also plays a major role for the tentative conclusion. Charging the electric vehicle while being mobile might stand out to be the best option for this situation. Therefore, this paper proposes a wireless power transfer that can be done with the help of transmitter coil below the asphalt and receiver coils in the vehicle, wherein the transmitter coils are charged with solar panels. Due to over pollution, our natural resources are draining drastically and hence photovoltaic power boosts the charging both in the means of economic and efficient ways.

articleTitle: E-commerce Merchant Fraud Detection using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: At present, e-commerce has become a global phenomenon. With the great achievement of ecommerce, many are cruel Promotional services are also increasing: with the aim of growing sales, spiteful marketers try to improve their target spectators by improving the outcomes of an illegal search using false travel, shopping, etc. In this report, we read about the problem of deception in major commerce platforms. First, we want to list the merchant fraud, the names of those who have previously committed fraud in the business will be marked on the list. And will train machines using machine learning approach. So that, if a merchant id is given in the system, it can detect whether the id is fraud or not. Our lesson here paper is predictable to hut light on the defense in contradiction of e-commerce fraud of active commerce platforms. In this research report, we proposed a machine learning model to analyze and identify merchant fraud. As a machine learning model, we choose the Random forests, decision tree and logistic regression algorithm for our model.

articleTitle: Second Sale Car Price Prediction using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Every business firm recognizes the need of making sound and challenging decisions. Poor decisions can lead to substantial losses and even the demise of a firm. This paper is focused on one of the retail enterprises, which deals with the used car sales. The major goal is to develop a prediction model that can estimate the selling price of used cars based on key factors. Machine learning techniques such as Random Forest Regression, Feature engineering technique such as Extra Trees Regression are employed to accomplish the goal as Random Forest Regression is modeled for prediction analysis and Extra Trees Regression fits the number of decision trees. The results are so encouraging with our approach.

articleTitle: Fabrication of Low Cost Food Delivery Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In today’s world, technology has drastically increased in all sectors of industries and businesses. Automated machines demands have increased rapidly. Most small and medium scale businesses are trying to use this technology to increase the speed and reliability. One of the booming technologies is robotics, which helps businesses in so many ways. This paper discusses the approach and experience in the design, simulation, modelling, testing, and deployment of a Low-Cost food delivery robot in hotels, restaurants etc. These food delivery robots give an enhanced experience for the customers and benefits the restaurant business financially by bringing attention to visitors and act as a publicity. The restaurant industry is also experiencing a downturn because of the COVID-19 breakout. With this method, food can be delivered directly from the kitchen to the customer’s table while maintaining all norms and sanitary guidelines. The robot uses microcontroller mounted with DC motors. Ultrasonic sensors and IR sensors are used for mapping and localization of destination tables, motor drivers, obstacle detection, collision avoidance, path detection. The robot performed as per the test and achieved the desired result.

articleTitle: Emotion Recognition in Tweets using Optimized Ensemble Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)

authors.preferredName: P V G D Prasad Reddy

abstract: The development of superior recognition/ classification techniques is essential for real-time Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications. Sentiment Analysis (SA) is a task of NLP that aims to extract the sentiments/ opinions of the people from texts. In addition, very recent SA techniques start to integrate the data from text, speech, and other modalities such as visual data. Effective computing techniques and SA techniques are the two keys to the development of Artificial Intelligence (AI) such as human computer interaction. This article presents the investigations on sentiment classification of political tweets about an individual on Twitter using optimized Ensemble classifier under different training rates. From the analysis done through simulation, it is noted that Ensemble Classifier (EC) provides better classification accuracy than that of traditional machine learning (ML) classifiers.

articleTitle: Design of Vacant Seat Detection in a Moving Bus Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: IoT plays a major role in the latest automation, and the digitalization of many services such as booking, etc. has significant changes in the industry but with digital digitalization, there are some challenges that you have to deal with. One of those challenges is not the availability of vacant seats after the booking period has expired and this finding vacant seats can be very helpful for passengers and the transport company to turn them around. IoT technology sensor helps collect information about empty seats using one of the sensors detected with MCU and GPS module that activate the central server with signals to unlock booking at the next bus stop. The main goal is to solve the problem of allocating empty seats in a moving bus using IoT.

articleTitle: ECG Signal Classification using Deep Neural Networks with Ensemble Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) is a vital signal, used to identify cardiovascular diseases like arrhythmias, heart attacks and coronary heart diseases. The classification of ECG signals help doctors to give correct treatment of a particular disease. Our proposed work based on classification of five classes. This research study has used a stack of neural networks, ensemble techniques like Dropout, global maxpooling and data sets like MITBE PTBDB which are considered as the open source databases. Data pre-processing is done by using resampling and normalization techniques. The proposed CNN-BiLS TM-Attention mechanism has obtained an accuracy of 98.9% and F1score of 0.947. Comparing to existing methods, the proposed method improves the accuracy.

articleTitle: Implementation of Robotics for Child Rescue from Bore Hole using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The most vital component of life is water. Bore wells are dug to meet the growing demand for water. Several children have become stuck after slipping into abandoned bore wells that have been left open to the elements. The present rescue systems are inefficient and inaccurate since they rely on manual assistance, which is prone to human mistake. The main aim of our project is to save the child from the bore well how much ever deep the child is. So here this research study has proposed an advanced robotic system for rescuing the child from a bore well. The robot uses a surveillance camera to monitor the movements of the child which can be viewed through the Internet of Things application. Hand gripper is used to rescue the child which is controlled using microcontrollers. This system uses an ultrasonic sensor, gas sensor, temperature sensor and pulse sensor. The facial feeling of the kid is perceived through camera and Voice playback is used to communicate to the child continuously to keep it alive. An Internet of Things application is created to monitor the sensor recordings and control the robotic hand gripper simultaneously in the same panel using microcontrollers. The proposed system will easily rescue the child without any major injury.

articleTitle: Designing Inventory system Utilizing Neural Network in the prediction of Machine Learning-based Design
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Inventory management system is a process involved in tracking the goods throughout the whole supply chain from the moment of purchasing to production sales at the end. Microsoft Excel spreadsheet is a good example of Inventory management software. An inventory management system is required to precisely track the status of our business, otherwise without such a system the business would often run into situations where it would be either understocked or overstocked. The system also informs about the number of raw reactants required to produce the final product and if the ingredients are available or not. There are way too many inventory management system for us to choose from, ranging from simple to comprehensive solutions. The machine learning aspect along with the very important deep learning aspect has been very important in designing how it can be structured with a real ease and mainly with a good credibility and faster solutions. The main approach which is followed by the authors is to use the deep learning techniques such as recurrent neural networks, convolution neural network and artificial neural network and find out the best accuracy and also prove the best algorithm for the following problem statement.

articleTitle: MRI and Spect Medical Image Fusion using Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Image fusion’s goal is to merge material from multiple images of the same scene into a single image that preserves the essential and required features of each original image. Today, with the rapid development of high-tech and modern instrumentation, medical imaging has become a vital component of a wide range of applications including diagnosis, research, and treatment. Medical picture fusion is the principle to enhance image quality by fusing pictures obtained from different imaging instruments such as computed tomography (CT), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), positron emission tomography (PET) and computed tomography (SPECT) with single photon emission. SPECT contains the details about the functioning and blood flow of our tissues and organs for medical diagnosis. Magnetic Resonance Image (MRI) offers stronger, more distortion information on soft tissue. In this case, just one type of image may not be enough to provide the physicians with accurate clinical requirements. The fusion of the multimodal medical images is therefore needed. This paper introduces an image fusion approach that is based on discrete wavelet transformation. 2-Dimensional DWT for decomposing an image. The fusion performance is evaluated using Mutual Information (MI) and Correlation of Fused Image and Reference Image.

articleTitle: Facial Emotion Recognition using DCNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Facial emotion recognition (FER) is critical for human-computer interaction in areas like clinical practice and behavioral description. With the heterogeneity of human faces and kinds of images like various facial poses such as happy, angry, sad, fear, disgust, surprised etc. and lighting, accurate and robust FER by computer models remains a challenge. Deep learning models, particularly Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (DCNNs), have shown great promise among all FER techniques due to their powerful automatic feature extraction and computational of efficiency. On the FER2013 dataset, the highest single-network classification accuracy has been attained in this paper. The VGGNet architecture is used, its hyper parameters are fine-tuned, and different optimization techniques are performed. This proposed model has achieved the state-of-the-art single-network accuracy of 90% on FER2013 without using any additional training data.

articleTitle: Reversible Image Steganography Techniques: A Performance Study
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Reversible image steganography is one of the widely researched areas. The important reason behind this is, it reconstructs the actual version of the cover image exclusive of loss. Several techniques have been proposed for better performance in the past and even today. But still, there exists a gap in the literature that leads to further research and improvement of the previous techniques. In this article, a performance study is carried out on reversible image steganography techniques. The techniques over the past two decades were compared along with standard test images. PSNR and embedding capacity are taken into consideration as the evaluation parameters. The experimental results of each technique were tabulated and compared to provide insight. An in-depth analysis and descriptive statistics are done to give a clear understanding of the performance of each technique. The article offers a detailed assessment of the past techniques concerning the standard test.

articleTitle: A Novel Framework for Classfication of Hyperspectral Images
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Identification of land cover changes in hyperspectral images is one of the thought-provoking topics in the remote sensing community. This is due to the higher dimension of data cube, redundancy, noise and correlation among data. The present paper focus on designing a novel framework to address some of the aforementioned issues. Firstly, spectral features are extracted through nonlinear principal component analysis followed by a convolutional neural network with the extracted features. The constructed net is found to be suitable for most of the hyperspectral cubes. The constructed framework performance is tested with benchmark hyperspectral data. The reported performance depicts the novelty of the architecture. on the three selected data sets.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Clustering and Routing Using GA-EAMMH
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The goal of this research is to increase the energy efficiency of wireless sensor networks by clustering and routing them more efficiently. Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are used to collect, process, and distribute data in a number of commercial and military applications. WSN can achieve its energy-saving aims through optimising clustering and routing (listed above). The energy conservation aspect for sensor nodes is one of the important design issues for a sensor network. In wireless sensor networks, increasing network longevity is critical, and it can be accomplished by improving Clustering and Routing. In this paper, a novel technique called Genetic Algorithm-Energy aware multi-hop multi-path hierarchical (GA-EAMMH) is introduced that, when compared to existing algorithms like GA and LEACH, improves network longevity.

articleTitle: Exploring Text Mining Techniques for Business Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: COVID-19 pandemic has created a huge impact on people around the world. Even though most of the people have encountered negative experiences, there are some people who take this as an advantage and exploit this opportunity. Difficult conditions have been adapted by companies to survive the Covid-19 situation. This paper is mainly focused to identify the business lines developed around Covid-19 and their impact on the business environment, applying text mining methodology. The analysis uses open-source software Python Anaconda which mainly focuses on the areas of business and marketing. Four different areas of intervention are identified in the results. It is found that the common factors that have been impacted are the new forms of action which majorly improve the people's quality of life.

articleTitle: Structured Query Language (SQL) based College Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This work focuses on online approval of requests in universities and digitization like leave requests, out pass requests, on-duty approval, and university admission management system. The most difficult challenge that college students face is getting permissions and leaves granted. For all sorts of approval, many colleges still employ manual and archaic methods. Maintaining attendance and reports for students is also a difficult process and a lot of manpower is required. To make it easier and simpler, an app is created and published among universities to make all the processes digital and online. The main objective of this work is to develop an application that solves the difficulties of the traditional method. The application is developed from a hyper-automation development platform designed for all business sizes. Structured Query Language (SQL) is used for creating tables and managing data in the database. This application will be useful for teachers and students to become automated in permissions, leaves requests, and related reports and records.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Transmission Gate based VCO Architectures for Better Performance
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Two novel transmission gate based voltage controlled oscillators (TG-I VCO and TG-N VCO) have been proposed in this paper. Both the TG based VCOs have been designed using 26 transistors. It has been noted that the TG-I VCO operates from 18.965 MHz to 1.925 GHz, and the TG-N VCO operates from 4.5 MHz to 4.28 GHz. The tuning ranges are found to be 99.015% and 99.89% respectively. Also, the values of gain obtained are 14.2 Grad V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> & 17.5 Grad V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> respectively. The phase noise responses of both the TG-I VCO and TG-N VCO obtained from the phase noise analyses will be -135.42 dBc/Hz@1MHz and -127.29 dBc/Hz@1MHz respectively. The circuits were created in Cadence Virtuoso Environment and were executed in GPDK 180nm library of CMOS Technology using a supply voltage of 1.8 V.

articleTitle: Predicting the Vulnerability of Covid-19 using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this research, a quantitative model is developed to predict people’s susceptibility to Covid-19 supported by their comorbid diseases and factors associated with Covid19. Researchers have found that individuals with comorbid diseases have higher chance of being infected and developing more severe Covid-19 conditions. However, these patterns are only observed through correlational analyses between patient phenotypes and the severity of their Covid-19 infection. The research reported in this paper presents a comprehensive approach to determine the impact of pre-existing disorders on Covid-19. This might be substantiated by a complete study of the patient level dataset, which includes their prior conditions, vital health information, and age group, as well as the influence of Covid-19 on them. The analysis revolves around how each disease affects a patient’s immunity, which includes endpoints such as admission of patients to a regular ward, semi-ICU, or ICU. Monitoring the patient’s current conditions, supports the final outcome.

articleTitle: Cost-Effective Distributed Booster Load Balancer in Amazon Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The amazon cloud provided an opportunity to build the infrastructure from anywhere in the world. Through the AWS cloud, multiple virtual machines can be created and integrated with a virtual network. The fixed size of virtual machines does not suit the time of a growing organization. The sales business trading will change time-to-time. While building the cloud setup, starting all the virtual machines at a time may lead to resource wastage. This issue could be eliminated by the Distributed Booster Load Balancer (DBLB) which can distribute the load equally among the machine during peak hours and launch the instance based on demand. In the case of non-peak hours whenever the threshold limit exceeds the number of virtual machines gets increased and the load is distributed equally to all machines. Whenever the load is up to the fixed threshold the newly created virtual machine gets stopped and resumes back based on the load. The proposed approach is demonstrated in the AWS cloud portal which provides good target response time, throughput, and load distribution.

articleTitle: A Model for Analysis of Diseases Based on Nutrition Deficiency Using Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper presents a method to analyze a person’s health and seek diseases that may develop shortly depending on dietary intake. Only a nutritious and well-balanced diet can keep one’s health in check. Non-communicable diseases (NCDs) are the world’s most serious public health and development problems. Appropriate nutritious diets have long been recognized as crucial preventative and control approaches for NCDs. Using Machine Learning approaches, we investigated the association between dietary elements and illnesses in this article. To begin, we received more than ten ailments and gathered the required food elements for each condition. After that, we suggested an enhanced approach based on rough sets to determine which dietary substances might positively impact illnesses utilizing Random Forest, Decision Tree (DT), and K-nearest neighbors’ (KNN) algorithms. This is the first extensive research in India to use machine learning to investigate the association between nutritional elements in food and illness. Experiments on real-world data reveal that our machine-learning-based solution outperforms the Gaussian Nave Bayes methodology, with the most fantastic accuracy of 0.96. Our research can predict the disease based on the first three dietary items with nutritional value, which might help recover persons afflicted with those ailments. These findings show that machine learning can be useful in identifying dietary elements in food for disease analysis.

articleTitle: Data Analytics for Parameter Estimation of an Electric Bicycle using IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Bicycles have transformed from being a recreational product into an environmentally friendly transportation tool. With electric bicycles, individual public transportation can be supported in large cities throughout the world. Electrical components reduce the amount of human power necessary to perform a task. There have been many changes to the current environment as a result of human interaction. Through the use of a qualitative descriptive approach, this study provides knowledge about the effects of riding an electric bicycle on the environment. In short, the electric bicycle is not the only development in the field of cycling that is provided by its diversity. This paper proposes a cycle that runs on alternative sources and reduces human efforts in transportation. A battery-operated cycle is considered as an alternative mode of transportation to benefit the society and environment. Electric vehicles have environmental benefits and also have zero emissions, due to which they are attracting more attention from all over the globe. In order to develop an electric bicycle with low cost, greater range, and an ideal motor, this research work considers the rider’s mass, vehicle dimensions and slope into consideration. Using these inputs, a simulation has been conducted. Various dynamic equations have been used in order to simulate the performance of the bicycle in certain operating conditions. The dynamic equations have been solved using Scilab-Xcos. The proposed study has determined the required wattage of the bicycle with the help of this simulation.

articleTitle: Real-Time Object Size Dimensioning in Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Real-time object size dimensioning and detection is playing a crucial part in industry today and in the coming days of technological advancement. Object Size Dimensioning is a framework for estimating the dimensions i.e., length and breadth of real-time objects. To demonstrate the efficiency of the suggested system, the demonstration has been implemented and shown in Raspberry Pi. The proposed approach includes an item or object that is identified using improved techniques for detecting edges. For calculating dimension, a reference item (a binary coded marker) has been taken based on characteristics that items used as reference can be identified easily and have fixed measurements. This model has been proposed using the Open CV python module in Raspberry Pi, for determining the dimensioning of an object using a fixed reference.

articleTitle: Deep Net based Framework for Hyperspectral Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Hundreds of contiguous spectral bands equipped with Hyperspectral Image (HSI) can be useful in the classification of several ground materials which has impact on various applications. On the other side, large amount of spectral bands information creates an issue like increase in computational complexity and redundant information among spectral bands. The present paper among this issue by incorporating PCA for dimensionality reduction of HIS data. Furthermore CNN model is designed and implemented for robust classification. To verify the efficacy of the current framework, experiments are carried out on three datasets like Indian pines, University of Pavia, and Salinas. The qualitative and quantitative result analysis is witness to prove effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Bandwidth Estimation with Mobility Control in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Multimedia application has recently attracted interest in mobile ad hoc network (Manet). Channel allotment depends on bandwidth available at node and minimum bandwidth needed by a new traffic flow. The guarantee of quality of service relies on the ability of prediction and estimation of available bandwidth. The available bandwidth is crucial resource because it is limited. However no mechanism has been standardized to estimate the accurate available bandwidth. Recent researches have been done on new techniques to estimate the available resources in ad hoc networks but mobility criteria has not been considered. This research work has implemented a bandwidth estimation technique and considered the importance of mobility criteria. Mobility control is incorporated in bandwidth estimation technique. Simulation is carried out using NS 2.35. Performance of bandwidth estimation with mobility control is compared with best effort routing protocol ad hoc on demand distance vector (AODV). Bandwidth estimation with mobility control performs better compared to bandwidth estimation and AODV in terms of throughput, delay, packet delivery ratio and energy consumption.

articleTitle: Software Download to Radio Network Elements from NMS: New Method
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Software download to Radio Network Elements (or NEs or base stations or Access points or xNBs) has been traditionally made using server-client method. Server being in Network Management System (NMS) and Base Station (or xNBs) acts as client in this case. Each client/network element downloads the same software image from server one by one. This puts a lot of stress on NMS when there are hundreds or thousands of network elements in the network and when the software image size of each of the network element is large. This paper proposes a new method to perform software download to the network elements in network. It uses peer-to-peer(P2P) distribution of software image to base stations where NMS server acts as Tracker, knowing topology, and clients as Seeders and Leechers, uploading and downloading pieces of software image. This, of course still requires software images to be downloaded to some of the base stations in traditional way since there are seeders in P2P network, and tracker needs to know topology to be able to place these initial seeders in optimal places. The communication between base stations can be enabled through X2 interface in case of LTE networks and Xn interface in case of 5G networks.

articleTitle: LSTM and CNN based Stock Price Prediction APP
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The Stock Market is one of the most important parts of today’s economy. The prices of the stock market represent the growth of the economy of that country. For many years researchers from various parts around the world have been studying various methods for predicting the next trends in the stock market. One such method for predicting stock prices is machine learning. Machine learning is quite effectively implemented in forecasting the prices of various Stocks. Stock market prediction is a difficult problem in machine learning. It can be extremely complex. In this project I will attempt to implement an LSTM model to analyze the stock market data accurately predictions about whether the stock prices are going to go up or if they are going down. LSTMs are extremely efficient in predicting the trends in stock prices because they’re able to store previous information. This is crucial because, the previous price of a stock is required in order to make the predictions on what the future price of that stock will be. The main purpose of this is to be able to make well educated and informed decisions about the investments in the stock market and ensure that a profit margin is maintained through trading various stocks.

articleTitle: Estimation of Remaining Useful Life(RUL) of BLDC Motor using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The remaining useful life (RUL) is the capability of the machine to function before a replacement or repair is required. Estimation of RUL is considered to be important in predictive maintenance because it helps in optimizing the operating efficiency and to avoid unplanned downtime. The proposed project is based on the detection and calculation of RUL life of BLDC motor. For calculating the remaining useful life of BLDC motor parameters like temperature, current and voltage are measured from the sensors connected to the ARM7LPC2148 board and the values are given as data sets to the machine learning algorithm. The obtained data sets are trained using Machine learning algorithms like K-Nearest Neighbor(KNN), Gaussian Naïve Bayes,Random forest and Support vector machine(SVM).The main idea of the proposed project is that it can be used in the estimation of RUL in real time and they are also independent of external factors like temperature etc., Experimental results indicate that Random Forest algorithm is found to be efficient in terms of metrices like accuracy, precision, F1 score and recall. And hence RUL is estimated from random forest algorithm and the accuracy of the algorithm is 88%.

articleTitle: Cylindrical Dielectric Resonator Antenna design for Satellite Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This study discusses the design of a Cylindrical Dielectric Resonator Antenna (CDRA) for satellite applications using the High Frequency Structural Simulator (HFSS) software. This research focuses on the impacts of various dielectric materials in C-band dielectric resonator antennas for satellite applications. A circular microstrip patch antenna for 4.2 GHz is developed, simulated, and optimized using the HFSS to match the frequency and get the desired results. A cylindrical dielectric material is placed on top of the patch to investigate outputs. Materials having a higher dielectric constant is found to produce higher gain and lower return loss. The HFSS simulator generates outputs such as gain charts, VSWR, return loss, radiation pattern.

articleTitle: Mental Health and Personality Determination using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The purpose of this project is to use textual comments collected from users via a web application to predict their mental health and personality. Data encoding was performed using Label Encoder and Count Vectorizer. Machine learning models like Logistic Regression, SVM, Random Forest, Naive Bayes, and KNeighbors Classifier were built and models were trained on the dataset, the machine learning model which has the highest accuracy score has been selected. The predicted accuracy given by k fold Cross-Validation shows that the XGBoost classifier gives the best accuracy of 67.68 percent for personality prediction and predicts 16 distinct personality types across four axes based on their introversion, intuition, reasoning, and perceived abilities, even when tested on the same dataset. Whereas Logistic Regression predicts mental health with the maximum accuracy of 96.05 percent.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Framework and Process Optimization Algorithm for Foreign Propaganda Machine Translation based on Multi-Cultural Information Collection and Clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: An intelligent framework and process optimization algorithm for foreign propaganda machine translation based on multi-cultural information collection and clustering is designed and implemented in the paper. This paper establishes a term translation model and a joint translation model. The term translation model binds the translation probability of a term to the topic distribution of the document in which it is located, so as to guide the selection of translations that match the topic during term translation. With these theoretical information, the novel machine translation model will be defined. Phrase-based statistical machine translation does not conduct the in-depth linguistic analysis of the core source language and target language, but divides the source language sentences to be translated into word strings. The proposed research article integrates the multi-cultural information collection and clustering model to design the intelligent framework and process optimization algorithm for foreign propaganda machine translation. Through the experiment, the performance is finally validated.

articleTitle: Bidirectional RNN for Audio Deep Learning in an End-to-End Model
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: ASR (automated speech recognition) is a feature that enables users of information systems to input data by speaking rather than punching numbers into a terminal. These advancements empower machines to answer human voices precisely and reliably, permitting to convey helpful and significant services. Individuals would pick such a gadget since speaking with a machine through voice is quicker than utilizing a console. Since communicating in language rules human correspondence, it’s just typical for individuals to anticipate voice interfaces for PCs. This can be accomplished by making discourse-to-message programming that empowers a gadget to change over voice orders and correspondence into messages. The acoustic model, language model, and vocabulary model are the three models of a run-of-the-mill ASR framework. Various examples of voice, the environment, which requires foundation commotion, and the speaker’s intonation are altogether hindrances in automatic speech recognition. The key idea is to investigate the spectrogram and MFCC highlights of information sound signals and make state-of-the-art profound learning models. It prepared an acoustic model utilizing RNN-GRU (Recurrent Neural Network-Gated Recurrent Unit) in the Librispeech dataset and then executed a language model utilizing Bert to improve the presentation of the acoustic model carried out. Whenever prepared from start to finish with reasonable regularization, it observes that RNN-GRU accomplishes a higher word blunder rate. When compared to a higher word blunder rate, a lower word blunder rate implies superior discourse acknowledgement execution. In automatic speech recognition, profound learning procedures make it simpler to diminish the pace of word mistake rate.

articleTitle: Signal Processing Method for Enhancement of Pulse Oximeter Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Pulse oximeters are now a part of every household first-aid kit, pulse oximeters have actually helped to primarily identify the severity of covid19 infection in a person’s body. These devices measure the saturated blood oxygen level (SpO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) in a person’s body, there by the displayed level of SpO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> helps medical professionals to hypothesize the situation and provide a better aid for the patient. Since the process is non-invasive, the devices are widely implemented. Pulse oximeters acquire photoplethysmographic (PPG) signals, these signals contain the volumetric changes in human blood, that on being exposed to mathematical principles give the SpO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> reading and other data. The process of obtaining the PPG signals through pulse oximetry employs a mechanism of emitting and detecting the IR and Red signals through human tissues, however during the capturing of reflected signals through detector, the detected signal comes along with noise referred as motion artifact (MA). These MAs arises due to the voluntary/involuntary movements of human causing volumetric changes in flow of blood at the source and detector sensor locations. The presence of MAs in such signals turns up to erroneous SpO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> level estimation, that creates a problem for medical professionals in treating the diseases. To improve the reliability of SpO2 estimation, by a pulse oximeter, the PPG signal quality is to be enhanced. In this paper, the authors tried to describe on the work of enhancing the acquired PPG signal quality by reducing MAs with effective methods.

articleTitle: Early Stage Ischemic Stroke Prediction using Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Stroke is the second leading cause of death worldwide, and it continues to be a major health issue for both people and public health systems. Stroke is a dangerous condition. When the blood flow to a portion of human brain is interrupted, cerebrum tissue is deprived of oxygen and nutrients, it results in a condition called stroke. Nevertheless, the brain cells begin to die in a matter of minutes. This research intends to infer a model condition for developing a stroke pre-analysis algorithm with the possibly modifiable risk factors. Ischemic embolic and haemorrhagic strokes represent the bulk of strokes. Consequently, the objective of the proposed research work is to apply the standards of Convolution Neural Network (CNN) over the huge existing datasets to predict the most likely life threatening risks that might follow the primary occurrence. Further the refinement in these algorithms could give immense utility in clinical settings and stroke treatment and furthermore provide more knowledge on the new advancements and utilization of CNN in neuroimaging focuses on analyzing the intense ischemic stroke and apply Le-Net CNN model to process the patient profile data.

articleTitle: Multi-terminal Software Implementation of Online Big Data Platform for High-Skilled Personnel Training in Hubei Province from the Perspective of Artificial Intelligence Industry Upgrading
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Multi-terminal software implementation of online big data platform for high-skilled personnel training in Hubei Province from the perspective of artificial intelligence industry upgrading is studied in the paper. Artificial intelligence technology has brought about the intelligence, automation and intelligence of production, and a large number of the manual workers have been replaced by intelligent machines, which requires a large number of high-quality compound technical skills in artificial intelligence. The application software of the monitoring terminal is the key to then realize the monitoring function. The application program of the monitoring terminal includes modules such as input/output control, data processing and display, and general communication with the host compute and then, with the integration of these models, this paper proposes the novel perspectives. Through the experimental analysis, the results are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Application of Multi-Dimensional Data Capture Algorithm in the Intelligent System for Improving the Supply Quality of Guangdong Rural Commercial Endowment Insurance
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The supply quality of rural commercial endowment insurance This paper is based on the current situation of my country’s rural endowment insurance system, and on the basis of the existing research on my country’s rural endowment insurance system by domestic experts and scholars, to discuss the application of multi-dimensional data mining in the supply quality of rural endowment insurance in Guangdong, and to explore the application of multidimensional data mining in rural endowment insurance supply quality in rural areas. fully play its important role in the old-age security system. Based on various application characteristics of multi-dimensional analysis technology, a prototype system for multi-dimensional analysis of endowment insurance was designed and implemented, and a better method for automatic acquisition of decision-making knowledge in endowment insurance business was proposed. The results show that the insurance supply quality improvement course can promote the reform of the insurance marketing management system in rural areas, and improve the marketing and service improvement of commercial pension insurance companies.

articleTitle: Global Dissemination of Minority Music Under the Background of the Internet: based on the Technology of Multimedia Central Station
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: At present, under the background of globalization, the inheritance environment of minority folk original ecological music in my country has undergone tremendous changes, and the public’s aesthetic mentality has also changed. The reason for this phenomenon is that the inheritance ecology of the original music of ethnic minorities has been destroyed. Based on the in-depth analysis of the opportunities and threats brought by Western music culture, this paper designs a central station and a subcenter for the dissemination of ethnic music. The system physical model of the station multimedia host mode and the system physical model of the multimedia workstation mode. The curriculum model and other aspects are reformed in a targeted manner, so as to give full play to the role of ethnic music education to a greater extent, and promote ethnic music to adapt to the background of globalization and better integrate into the world.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Detection and Prediction of Omicron Diagnosis on Collected Symptoms
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Active inspection of Omicron variant enables rapid and effective analysis of COVID-19 variant. It can diminish the encumbrance on health systems. Detection and forecast models combine many qualities for calculation. The hazards of infection have progressed. The goal is to aid health care professionals globally in case of critical Omicron long-suffering persons, specifically in the situation of inadequate well-being means. The developed deep learning research approach was trained on the dataset of 900 verified persons (among which 500 were inveterate, to partake Omicron variant). The training test-set delimited the dataset from the succeeding days (700 verified persons, of which 300 were inveterate, to partake Omicron). The proposed research prototype spotted and forecasted Omicron examined outcomes with good correctness and little error rate using only six unique features such as gender, age ≥ 50 ages, known traces with a disease distinct, and the presence of four preliminary medical indications. The developed research prototype notices Omicron infected cases via easy qualities retrieved through posing elementary queries or data queries. The proposed research outline can be useful, amid additional attention, to arrange to examine Omicron while checking properties are insufficient.

articleTitle: Implementation of Smart Home using Finite State Machine Model
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Security is always the need of the hour in a home. An automation system, which provides security as well as comfort, ensures reliability and ease. This helps making life convenient. A project with a system of detection of fire and intrusion through the doors and windows, which gives both comfort and security along with theft detection, fire alarm, heater, air conditioner, water tank and luminosity, gives not only a sense of security, but also comfort. A smart Verilog code for a smart home is implemented for the above features in this paper. A separate Finite State Machine (FSM) is used for each feature. Thus, synthesizing the Verilog code on Xilinx platform with verification of waveforms and simulation outputs are achieved.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Circular Fractal Antenna for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A fractal antenna based on a circular spiral circular patch is presented and built for use in wireless applications in aeronautical radionavigation, such as navigation. The circular patch is placed on the FR4 substrate with a radius of 10mm, and the circular slots are introduced into the circular patch in order to improve the performance of the antenna by increasing the number of circular slots, the paper proposes ISM and Wimax applications. At 4.2111 GHz, the suggested antenna has a return loss of -21 dB and a VSWR of 1.1, which are both negative values. The antenna measures 20 millimeters in diameter. Due to the fact that the suggested antenna provides great performance while being small in size, it is particularly well suited for wireless applications. HFSS simulation tool is used for designing work.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of TRANS - GAN Architecture for Bio-Medical Image Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In the area of biomedical image processing, medical image segmentation plays a crucial role. Today due to the deep sculptures of deep neural networks and innovative by-passes like the Transformers this field has rejuvenated. This paper analyzes various algorithmic advancements regarding Transformers and Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) which have paved the anatomy of image segmentation. The GAN network is not only able to regenerate feature spaces but also can transpose the inputs from the transformer. These algorithms are not only at par with the bifurcation of networks like U-net and ResNet but showcase a strong and more intuitive idea of human neural intelligence. Finally, all methods are compared based on accuracy, dice score, architectural evaluation, etc. The ability of these networks are deduced to regenerate and recreate the feature spaces for the given input image and thus can segment high features for prediction.

Author Keywords: Generative Adversarial Networks Convolutional Neural Network

articleTitle: Smart Vehicle Tracking System with Collision Avoidance
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A smart vehicle tracking system with collision avoidance is designed and implemented to track the movement of any vehicle at any time from any location and to avoid collision in crowded places. The proposed system used a popular technology that combines Raspberry pi with Web Application. Implementation of this system is easy and inexpensive compared to others. This smart system used global positioning system (GPS) and Global system for mobile communication for vehicle tracking. The device is placed in a vehicle whose position is to be determined/tracked. Microcontroller is used to control the GPS and GSM modules. This tracking system uses GPS module to obtain longitude and latitude coordinates of the desired vehicle at regular intervals of time. To transmit and update the location of vehicle into a database GSM Module is used. API Key is used to display the vehicle on the map in the web application. Thus, by using this web application one can continuously monitor the movement of vehicle. Here an ultrasonic sensor is used, if it detects the presence of any vehicle nearby, it immediately sends an alert message to the driver so that he can avoid the collision by taking diversion. This paper presents the experimental results of smart vehicle tracking system in order to show its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Human Face Mask Identification using Deep Learning with OpenCV Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: According to the WHO, COVID 19 virus is spread by respiratory droplets and personal contact. To prevent the transmission of this virus, the use of masks and social isolation is recommended. Because COVID 19 virus droplets may fall on any surface, the more crucial of the two measures is to wear a mask. It is vital to keep track of who is and is not wearing a mask. To comply with regulatory requirements, a mask recognition system capable of recognizing any kind of mask as well as masks in a variety of configurations inside video streams has been developed. To detect masks from images/video streams, a deep learning approach and the Python TensorFlow, Keras, and Pytorch packages are utilized. The suggested technology is capable of distinguishing persons who use masks from those who do not.

articleTitle: IoT & AI in Smart Farming: Implications and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Agriculture is a vital part in the life of people to survive in this world. An abundant food availability is highly essential for all living beings on this planet. Smart farming has been broadly considered as one of the furthermost feasible solutions for food inadequacy. In Modern era technologies has revolutionized the concept of agriculture into a new paradigm for better land productivity, better resource usage and better decision-making. The integration of the various trending technologies not only makes agriculture smarter and more efficient, but it also makes the entire system more sustainable. This paper reveals state-of-the-art technologies, their implications and the challenges associated with their implementation in the agriculture sector.

articleTitle: Design of Semicircular Microstrip Patch Antenna for Dual Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to propose and construct a semicircular patch-based microstrip antenna for dual band applications. The return loss and VSWR at 2.447GHz and 5.83GHz are -33dB, -19dB, and -1.0.1.2, respectively. It is being investigated whether the performance of the antenna improves as the number of slots increases. When the thickness of the substrate is increased, the performance suffers. Because the proposed antenna meets the requirements of both the ISM band and Wi-MAX, it is appropriate for usage in real-time applications.

articleTitle: Data Feedback Mining of College English Multimodal Online Guidance System based on the Fusion of TCP and UDP Protocols
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Data feedback mining of the college English multimodal online guidance system based on the fusion of TCP and UDP protocols is discussed in the paper. The multimodal guiding resource environment is a fluid environment based on modern information technology and social media. Based on the flipped classroom teaching model, this research constructs a smart platform composed of multiple modal resources and a social platform. The fusion of TCP and UDP protocols is the essential part of the designed method. Combined with characteristics of UDP data transmission and FPGA, this paper designs a high-speed data transmission system based on FPGA hardware platform using UDP data transmission technology. The platform is then integrated with the data feedback mining algorithm to show the robustness of the model. The test on the performance has proven the effectiveness.

articleTitle: K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) Algorithm based Dreck Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In recent years, with the expanded urbanization, the garbage output has tremendously increased. An increase in the population has resulted in a significant worsening status of cleanliness. To overcome this challenge, a research effort has been initiated towards proposing a dreck management system, where dreck refers to junk or trash present inside the bin. The spillover from the dreck affects the civic places by polluting the surrounding environment leading to different ailments in the surrounding area. This necessitates the need to implement a smarter waste management system to manage the garbage collection and monitoring process. In this paper, a Dreck management system has been introduced by utilizing a Jupyter Notebook. The proposed system has functionalities like garbage monitoring and alerting the authority when the dustbin becomes completely full. From the results of the proposed model, it is evident that the even the garbage collection process can be streamlined with the emerging intelligent and autonomous data processing technologies.

Author Keywords: Aeronautical Reconnaissance coverage graphical information system (ArcGIS)

articleTitle: Estimation of Total Harmonic Distortion in Three Phase Squirrel Cage Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The main aim of this research work is to determine one of the major power quality issues i.e. the amount Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) present in a three phase (squirrel cage) induction motor. In this work a simulation and case study for the effective estimation of THD is performed. The case study is performed with a power quality analyzer and the simulation work is carried out using MATLAB/SIMULINK software package. A three phase induction motor is operated without power electronic converters at different load levels and the corresponding THD values are measured and tabulated. Also various mitigation strategies to reduce the amount of THD present in an induction motor are analyzed in this paper.

articleTitle: Python Quantitative Dynamic Panel Big Data Analysis: Starting from the Game Algorithm of Consumption Environment and Rural Consumption Growth
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper discusses the relationship between rural consumption environment and rural economic growth within the framework of game theory. This paper argues that. The game process between government public investment and rural residents' consumption is an important way to promote rural economic growth. Using the system generalized moment estimation method, this paper conducts an empirical study on the relationship between my country's consumption environment and consumption growth. The results show that: improving the construction of infrastructure will significantly promote the growth of urban residents' consumption; perfecting the construction of my country's consumer finance market, optimizing the design of the test system for the Python quantitative investment platform, and formulating its implementation plan, which are currently many Python quantitative investments. Platform builders focus on issues.

articleTitle: A Food Recommendation System for Predictive Diabetic Patients using ANN and CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In the present society, many people are suffering from diabetes. To maintain a healthier diet, people must track the number of food calories they consume daily, along with their total calories. There is a growing desire for automated technologies that can help diabetics manage their diet and benefit the population by better analyzing the impact of different types of food on diabetes glucose levels. This research study includes two types of datasets: one for diabetic prediction and one for food recognition. This paper has implemented a diabetic prediction using ANN (3 dense layers), food recognition along with nutrient values by using the CNN model and transfer learning based on VGG16, and a food tracking system to track daily food along with total calories. Finally, our results will be available on the website, which can recognize food and track food items along with estimating calories. With the help of user input based on their glucose readings, the proposed model will predict whether the user has diabetes or not. Based on the user’s preference, they can use a food recognition and food tracking system.

articleTitle: Impact of the Metaverse on the Digital Future: People’s Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The Metaverse has been attracting significant attention from around the globe in recent years. Although the metaverse is in its infancy, it has the potential to bring about a massive transformation. Many companies are already developing the hardware and software that will enable virtual interactions to become more widespread. As the idea of the metaverse grows, where people can not only communicate with others but also work in virtual environments, researchers are seriously considering how the metaverse might influence peoples daily lives. This study aimed to examine the perceptions of people towards the metaverse and propose the metaverse as a concept for everyday life based on a review of bibliometric studies on metaverse-related publications. An online survey was conducted on different social media platforms to get an overview of the views of people. A total of 220 people took part in the survey. Participants gave their opinions about the Metaverse and how it would benefit them. This study employs bibliometric data to describe the metaverse as a concept for everyday life from the perspective of experts and survey respondents. This study concludes that the metaverse is a virtual world loaded with possibilities. It can provide a more realistic experience than reality.

articleTitle: Contribution of Blockchain in Development of Metaverse
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Metaverse is becoming the new standard for social networks and 3D virtual worlds when Facebook officially rebranded to Metaverse in October 2021. Many relevant technologies are used in the metaverse to offer 3D immersive and customized experiences at the user’s fingertips. Despite the fact that the metaverse receives a lot of attention and advantages, one of the most pressing concerns for its users is the safety of their digital material and data. As a result of its decentralization, immutability, and transparency, blockchain is a possible alternative. Our goal is to conduct a comprehensive assessment of blockchain systems in the metaverse to properly appreciate its function in the metaverse. To begin with, the paper introduces blockchain and the metaverse and explains why it’s necessary for the metaverse to adopt blockchain technology. Aside from these technological considerations, this article focuses on how blockchain-based approaches for the metaverse may be used from a privacy and security standpoint. There are several technological challenegs that need to be addressed for making the metaverse a reality. The influence of blockchain on important key technologies with in metaverse, such as Artifical Intelligence, big data and the Internet-of-Things (IoT) is also examined. Several prominent initiatives are also shown to demonstrate the importance of blockchain technology in the development of metaverse apps and services. There are many possible possibilities for future development and research in the application of blockchain technology in the metaverse.

articleTitle: A Review on Distributed Denial of Service Attack in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The improvement of Cyber-Physical-Systems and the incorporation of Information and Communication Technologies into the traditional power systems led to development of Smart Grid technology. These Cyber-Physical Smart Grid systems are critical infrastructures with complex architecture and diverse devices. These huge systems are prone to cyber attacks, that may lead to potential hazards which incur huge economy loss. Thoughplenty of cyber threats are feasible in smart grid, Distributed Denial of Service is one of the prominent threats that ought to be addressed. This paper comprehensively reviews the state-of-art techniques that addresses simulation, detection and mitigation mechanisms for Distributed Denial of Service attack that threatens the availability of Advanced Metering Infrastructure.

articleTitle: Cloud based Centralized Smart Cart and Contactless Billing System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Cloud computing with Internet of Things (IoT) has been proven to solve major problems that automation can face when data is processed on each device at a time. The problems include bulkier utility devices used to harbour high-capacity processors, difficulty in unifying different devices. IoT when combined with cloud computing, the system gives a unified platform to work on making the processing of data and cooperation between different devices hassle-free. The proposed Smart Cart and Billing System automates the billing process using a cloud facility to maintain user data and makes it easy for both the user and the admin to navigate through the database in real time. To ensure an efficient and secure network line, this research study has introduced a standard network of 802.11n hardware with a Software-Defined Wide Area Network (SD-WAN) architecture. Very few literatures have presented the cloud based centralised data management physical cart system. This is a unique approach to leverage fast wireless communication and centralised databases for minimising computational capacity consumption and latency.

articleTitle: A Survey on NIST Selected Third Round Candidates for Post Quantum Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The tremendous increase in the volume of data over internet for many applications such as banking, hospitals, insurance, online trading, messengers, voice communications and others has resulted in increased security threats. Due to the evaluation in the quantum computer generation, the classical cryptography algorithm will be broken in very less amount of time and lead to the security breaches and malicious attacks. The National Institute of Standard and Technology (NIST) has invited a new generation of Quantum Safe cryptography. First two rounds are completed successfully, and the finalist has been announced. This paper provides an in-depth examination of NIST third round selected candidates which are going to be the standard Post Quantum Cryptography (PQC) algorithm. Also, the limitations and attacking concerns related to that PQC algorithms are presented.

Author Keywords: N-th degree Truncated polynomial Ring Unit (NTRU)

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Identify Dynamic Deficiency in Cell using Gaussian NB Classifier
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: For the identification of intra-cell faults that may arise in returned products, a novel learning-guided technique has been described in this study. Assumed static flaws described by stuck-at errors are used in the first half of the study. Many supervised learning methods are investigated, with varied degrees of efficiency. The second section of the study is built on the earlier research by addressing more complex dynamic flaws. As part of the diagnostic procedure, a Naive Bayesian classification algorithm is applied to identify and categorise the type of each new data fault. The suggested approach’s reliability and clarity have been shown via testing on standard circuits and compared with a conventional cell-aware diagnostic tool.

articleTitle: A Survey on SDN Controller Evolution: A Brief Review
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The evolution of SDN is concerned with upcoming trends related to the management and monitoring of networks. SDN consists of many open-flow controllers which are utilized for research as well as commercialization area. SDNs control the applications to manage that improve network management and applications performance. These controllers are mostly running at the servers and consumers’ protocols for telling switch where to send the packet. This paper aims to review better architecture choices as designs for open-flow and open-source SDN controllers.
