Accordingly, on this study, we advise an Ensembled Transfer Learning (ETL) shape which explains clearly the separated cervical histopathological photos. In addition, we’ve created Xception, Inception-V3, Resnet-50 and VCG-16 models in the setup. At that factor, to support the order of execution, a weighted EL method is presented. From that factor onward, to proceed with the proposed calculation, a dataset comprising of around 500 photos, recolored through 3 immunohistochemistry techniques (Vascular endothelial growth factor-VEGF, Hypoxia-Inducible Factor-HIF and Aquaporins-AQP) is used. On testing, we gather the maximum accuracy over 97.03% and 98.61% on recoloring AQP pictures and recoloring VEGF pictures, separately. At last, a further test in the classification of harmless cell from a dangerous one is finished at the Herlev dataset and receives a popular exactness accuracy of 98.37%.

articleTitle: Effects of Different Laser Shape Pulses on Laser Wakefield Acceleration
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The authors of this work discuss the impact of varying laser shape pulses on laser Wakefield acceleration. Researchers have identified a relativistic plasma wave with an extraordinarily high electric field, which has the potential to be used to accelerate plasma particles in general, as well as for particle acceleration in general, according to the researchers. The acceleration process is fueled by a massive accelerating field gradient created by plasma wave, which acts as the primary motivator for acceleration process to take place and accelerate the plasma wave. A plasma wave provides the energy for the acceleration process. To ignite this kind of plasma wave, it is possible to produce an ionizing wakefield with a single laser, and the plasma wave will then interact with the laser itself. A wiggler magnetic field is utilized in this article to illustrate that augmentation of electron acceleration created by plasma wave may be investigated by deploying a plasma wave generator, which is described in detail elsewhere. A faster forward motion is required to make use of the higher resonance provided by the wiggler field, thus, electrons caught in the plasma wave are propelled forward at a faster pace. As a consequence, the amount of energy that the electrons accumulate throughout their acceleration increases dramatically.

articleTitle: Biker Safety System using Nano BLE 33 Microcontroller and Mobile App
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Two-wheelers are one of the most cost-effective and popular modes of transportation in the world. In India, 21.2 million two-wheeler units were sold in 2019, with the number expected to rise to 26.6 million units by 2025. Furthermore, global players in this sector, like as Bajaj and Hero MotoCorp, rely heavily on the Indian market for income. Unfortunately, the incidence of motorcycle-related traffic accidents is also on the rise. According to a 2017 figure, over 48,746 two-wheeler riders perished in traffic accidents, with 73.8 percent of them not wearing helmets. As a result of the irresponsible practise of not wearing a helmet, there are now four casualties every hour. The following project aims to design a safe and secure system for bikers that will ensure that the rider has worn the helmet in order to start a bike and also keep track of location in case of any calamity. Nano BLE 33 microcontroller has been used as it is a low-energy consumption microcontroller which is facilitated with multiple sensors like accelerometer, inbuilt Bluetooth communication and fast processing microprocessor. The above features make Nano BLE 33 light, compact, low power consuming and high processing making it ideal for such application. Mobile App is built with features like accident alerting, tracking and messaging in real-time. The above features aims at ensuring safety of the rider and in case of mishap, help reaches immediately.

articleTitle: Effective COVID Monitoring Process to Observe Patients Status using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Collecting important information helps physicians, specialists, and health care providers to simplify the care of their patients. However, because patients do not explicitly retain their data, autonomous possession and the right to protect personal data develop. This paper discovers the block chain’s potential to improve health care by placing the patient at the center of the system and improving health data protection and collaboration. The main goal of this research work is to discover the vast power of BitCoin technology that can be applied to patient records and health record protection management. As a dispensed era, Blockchain can be very beneficial, giving sufferers control over their statistics and impartial identification. With the COVID-19 pandemic, existing health information exchange systems are being put through the ringer. There is an increase in patient information sharing, as well as the need to respond to medical data requests more efficiently. There are some limitations in the current health information technologies, including the inability to remotely share medical data beyond their protected, local data stores. As a result, a secure and user-centric approach to accessing and controlling sensitive medical data is provided that is based on Blockchain immutability and decentralization. An innovative peer-to-peer system underpins the framework. Information is distributed through smart contracts that are connected to a blockchain-based protocol to ensure data integrity and traceability. Implementing the framework over a pilot study demonstrates its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Role of E-Learning in Educational Institutions: Analyzing its Impact on Students’ Satisfaction and Performance
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: E-learning is accomplished through the deep assimilation of modern educational and information technology. E-Learning is becoming more popular for learning in education due to the tremendous growth of internet technology. The main purpose of setting up an E-Learning is to improvise the course content and its accessibility. E-Learning helps the students of an educational institution to improve their scholastic performance. This research work intends to define the role of E-Learning in educational institutions and its positive impact on the student’s academic performance and students’ satisfaction with E-Learning. The determinants of E-learning considered in this work are (i) Knowledge Sharing (ii) Quality and (iii) Trust. These determinants will improve the satisfaction of students and enhance their academic performance of students. Also, this work comprises two phases: (i) Data collection and (ii) Data analysis. At the initial stage of this paper, data collection has been performed. For collecting data, a primary source of data collection has been performed. A structured questionnaire with 30 questions was prepared and distributed to the students of educational institutions. The questionnaire is prepared based on the developed hypothesis. In the second stage, the collected data analysis like SEM and ANOVA were performed. Using this analysis the goodness of fit and significant relation between the E-Learning and students of educational institutions were identified.

articleTitle: A Brief Analysis on Security Threats for Intrusion Detection in Network Coding Enabled Small Cells
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Network Coding (NC) enabled cellular networks can be penetrated by faulty packets that deviates the target nodes from decoding packets received. Even a little amount of pollution can be very quickly spread to remaining packets because of the resource exploitation at intermediary nodes. Numerous methods for protecting against data pollution attacks have been developed in the last few years. Another popular alternative is the Homomorphic Message Authentication Code (HMAC). Hackers can target HMAC by tampering with the end-of-packet tags, known as tag pollution assaults, in order to evade detection. To prevent data pollution and tag pollution assaults, a HMAC-based method can be used using two separate MAC tags. In the 5G wireless communication, small cells and collaborative networks have been extensively investigated. The use of network coding in wireless networks can increase throughput while consuming less power. Strong integrity procedures are essential for a coding environment to combat threats like pollution assaults and take full advantage of network coding. Latency and computation overhead can be reduced while maintaining security by modifying and optimising the existing integrity algorithms. This research focuses on analysing security threats in NC enabled small cells.

articleTitle: A Super-capacitor & Battery Based Energy Storage System For Electrical Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Some of the major sustainable improvement goals that will radically change our world are affordable or pure energy. Currently, researchers are focusing on less costly cinder electrode substances to boost electricity tankage devices, together with high power density super capacitors and Li-ion batteries. In this animadversion article, the focal point has been partial of unique kinds of herbal coal sources used for the synthesis of graphene and coal products/derivatives toward the fabrication of super capacitors with high electrochemical performance. The stipulation also includes the most recent news about synthetic strategies for these kinds of substances or their subsequent applications as electrodes in super capacitors, as well as the empirical elements of the super capacitors instituted internationally regarding these herbal resources. The fundamental idea behind the animadversion treatise is to recognize the respect of these herbal assets for use as precursors in large-scale harmony with quite a number of charcoal products and derivatives in a pecuniary way. This is the preceding animadversion treatise describing all possible instructions related to certain ordinary natural resources and their application to their charcoal derivatives or products for higher electrochemical properties. The intention of the composition remains all beneficial for future research work in the area of charcoal electrode substances derived from coal, graphite, and biomass, as well as their profitable utilization in super capacitor electricity tankage devices.

articleTitle: A review article on lane sensing and tracing algorithms for Advanced Driver Assistance Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this paper, the review on the sensing of lanes $\mathcal{E}$ trace algos utilizing hybrid automobile driver assistance modules is presented in brief. Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) and Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) improve safety while reducing fuel, pollution, and energy consumption. Lane detection and tracing are two basic ADAS features. Lane sensing is a technology that recognizes road lane lines. Lane monitoring helps the vehicle stay on track by employing previously evaluated lane markers to further drive the movement. Literature-based state-of-the-art-finding in this field is restricted. By offering a subjective study, this paper evaluates prior research on lane sensing and tracing algorithms. In order to decide the algorithm, it also condenses the metadata and benchmarks. Most studies focus on linear roadways, and it’s well accepted that cryptic road designs, such as plane curve roads, are rarely studied. Camera features, bad weather, indistinct line markers, and other factors all increase the impact of lane sensing and monitoring. Vehicle overtaking, as well as high-speed and high-luminescence findings, present a new challenge. A customized data set is the most popular data set used in many investigations. More decisive and powerful lane sensing and monitoring algorithms can be evolved and assessed using real-time statistics units as the ADAS sector expands in the future. This review article serves as a customized paper for the researchers who want to pursue research in this exciting field of transportation as we know that the economic progress of the country is like the speed of transportation.

articleTitle: Adoption of Cloud Computing to Accounting: Benefits and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Cloud computing is the most notable notion that has changed the traditional approach of offering accounting solutions. The bookkeeping industry is moving towards online goods. The numerous benefits of cloud services have been established that a technology revolution is unquestionably required in the accounting department of businesses. Cloud-based solutions have accelerated the pace of change in the accounting industry. Cloud computing services assist businesses in developing an inclusive strategy and prioritizing real-time and practical financial advice for clients. Cloud service providers have developed cloud-based accounting systems that offer significant benefits. Accounting on the cloud, enabled by cloud computing technology, is becoming a new commercial reality. Cloud accounting gives every company that uses it a lot of flexibility, allowing any company, big or little, to customize cloud software to match their individual needs. The risk of data imperfectness and incompatibleness that were present in prior techniques are reduced by using cloud based accounting solution. The main purpose of this article is to investigate the significance of cloud computing and its influence on accounting, as well as the factors to consider when using cloud computing in accounting and the benefits of cloud accounting. The study is done based on the existing literature related to cloud computing and its use in accounting.

articleTitle: Securing Web User Privacy with Steganalysis of Images using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Nowadays, images are extensively used in all aspects of community because of their ease of understandability, like cyber forensics and research-based exploration. Tampering digital images in special fields maliciously, may change the information contained therein, form false information, and result in damage to society. Data security is very important when sensitive data is transmitted over the internet. Whenever a website is opened, there are a lot of advertisements displayed on the page. Although they don’t intrude on our browsing experience, some images may hide vicious data inside them by using steganography. Hackers have become proficient in embedding their harmful code inside images. As soon as the user clicks on the image, the hidden code starts to affect the host machine by running in the background without the knowledge of the user. Henceforth, this research work proposes a system by using Deep Learning (DL) to detect steganography (Blind Steganalysis). Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) is used in our system to prognosticate the presence of steganography by providing an extension in the web browser. By testing our model, it’s inferred that the accuracy in finding hidden content in images shows good results. The proposed model has achieved an accuracy of 89 percentage.

articleTitle: An Automated Irrigation System with Movement and Sound Detection Sensor for Crop Shielding
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A substantial role in the improvement of nutrition production and crop management in India is played by the agricultural sector. Agriculture in this region is heavily reliant on excessive rainfall, which has a negative impact on India’s agricultural production. In order to increase agricultural productivity, there is a pressing need for efficient irrigation. The ability to manage how much water is provided and when it is administered defines the uniformity of the irrigation system, which is essential for optimizing the irrigation efforts. Proper irrigation management requires serious planning as well as constant monitoring. It has a plethora of advantages. Water irrigation and protection system frameworks that are precise are now considered to be important arrangements in their own right. While the study is focused on a water system plan that maximizes ground water availability, it also gives an effective approach for watering plants. After a suitable amount of water has been detected in the reservoir by the wetness sensor, automated water siphons on the agricultural site would be started and stopped by the watering structure in relation to the amount of wetness content gathered by the water level sensor. For the controlled calculation, the purposeful sensor estimations are supplied to the Arduino Uno microcontroller, which is programmed to do it. The protection is performed by the employment of noise detection and motion detection systems, which allow for the production of high-frequency sound, which protects the plants from diseases, worms, and other small animals that may otherwise harm them.

Author Keywords: and sound detection are all possibilities

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of An Intelligent IoT Based Solar Powered Aqua Harvester to Improve Blue Revolution
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Aquaponics is one of the quickest and most broadly growing enterprises. This task proposes not just ceaseless checking answers for assessing water's physiochemical boundaries but also appropriate, sincerely strong organization for data capacity, observing, separating, and sending the correct information to the ideal individuals with flawless timing. Moreover, the proposed system used for detailed monitoring of aquatic animals(fish) cultivation is based upon IoT (Internet of things), which helps produce fish and cultivate structures. Numerous sensors like pH sensors, temperature sensors, moistness sensors, and computerized point supporting were utilized in this project. By using these, everything is mechanized, and it is easy to screen.

articleTitle: Container based Driver Fatigue System using IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A fatigued driver is possibly considerably more dangerous on the road than a fast driver since he is prone to microsleeps. Researchers and manufacturers in the car industry are striving to solve this problem with a range of technical solutions aimed at preventing a catastrophe. A totally automated driver weariness state assessment system integrating driving video and a container-based approach is described, with a particular emphasis on tired driving detection In the suggested approach, the area of interest (ROI) is extracted using feature points, and face identification and feature point localization are accomplished using the convolutional network (CNN) architecture. to determine the condition of the eyes from ROI photos. The proposed CNN-based model might be used to develop a real-time driver drowsiness detection system for IoT devices that is both accurate and simple to use. This entire process is carried out within a container, which is a lightweight platform as a service that provides OS-level virtualization and portability. Surveillance has been elevated to a whole new level as a critical component of security measures with the introduction of signal processing technologies. The potential to give a lightweight alternative to heavier categorization models was achieved with Containerization and Dockerization. As a whole the model is to detect the drowsiness of the driver using IoT components, with Docker and Docker hub via cloud in a environment friendly way. The proposed model gives the prediction result with accuracy of 97% and the loss of 2.98%.

articleTitle: Optimization of Process Parameters for Semiconductor Devices using Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: According to modern technology, latest equipment and processes available for the manufacturing of semiconductor devices. As a part of this modern technology, optimization of the process includes evaluating all parameters such as temperature, pressure, measurements etc. Among several techniques carried out throughout the years, Artificial Neural network (ANN) is one efficient approach that comprises few classes and leads to processing advanced methods for predicting the requirement. Here the simulation makes possible for the minimization of time factor and cost, that could be considered a new approach. Google Colab has been considered in this work to run the implemented code that describes the whole network. The main theme is to optimize the fabrication process that results in thin film with least scale dimensions of a material which is to be implemented upon the substrate of a semiconductor. The purpose of this work is to optimize the processing parameters, such as processing pressure, thickness of Thin Film by varying the flow rate of Argon gas. Depending upon the different parameters the process of fabrication will get diminished. The network is to be trained by assuming input parameters, considering the figure-of-merits which leads to contract Testing time and long process of fabrication without doing any manual process.

articleTitle: Grey wolf and Fuzzy logic based enhanced clustering approach for energy efficient operation of wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A Wireless Sensor Network constitutes a collection of a large number of sensor nodes garrisoned in a given determined area so as to gather information and environmental data. They prove to be additionally beneficial in accumulating data from harsh environments where human intervention is scanty. The nodes are equipped with sensory, communication and computational capabilities which run on a battery which cannot be replaced effortlessly. Therefore, it becomes immensely important to work out an efficient, systematic and well-structured approach to inhibit power dissipation in the SNs so as to prolong the network lifetime, stability and service quality. This work puts forward a Grey Wolf optimisation(GWO) based procedure for cluster head selection and then employs fuzzy logic(FL) for efficient cluster development. The fitness parameters used in cluster head selection are remnant energy, standard intra cluster stretch, separation from sink, balancing factor and node degree. On the other hand, fitness of the CH and separation between node and a CH are the two parameters which serve as crisp inputs into the fuzzy inference system(FIS) in order to decide the cluster formation mechanism. On simulation of the proposed protocol and then comparing the results with corresponding protocols, our approach shows enhancements in the network performance metrics such as FND(First node death), residual energy, throughput.

articleTitle: Vehicular Communication Systems in Internet of Vehicles based on Machine Learning with Enhanced Security
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The increase in number of vehicles results in complication and overcrowding, and introduction to electrical vehicles, rises the need to intelligent driver less decision-making systems that use vehicular technology to increase protection and transport performance. The advancement of enhanced movement of advanced networks will increase assistance through highly dynamic heterogeneous networks for linked vehicles and 5G implementation brings with it a slew of new challenges. The cutting-edge technologies that allow operators to take use of newly available organization facilities. Machine Learning (ML), which is strong paradigm developing dynamic and forecasting systems, arisen in various fields such as academia, industry and so on. By studying driving behaviour and the surrounding environment using data from sensors, ML utilized to reduce accidents. Machine learning techniques defined with change in time slot which is essential for in-vehicle channel modelling. Vehicle-to-vehicle and traditional wireless networks, the machine learning address highly dynamic vehicular network concerns as conventional control design in loop and data-centric methods by using data-centric methods strategies for optimization. articleTitle: A Comparative Selection of Best Activation Pair Layer in Convolution Neural Network for Sentence Classification using Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Many natural language processing jobs need sentiment classification of text content. There is an urgent need, particularly with the rise of social media, to extract meaningful information from vast volumes of data upon that Internet utilizing sentiment analysis. We’re interested in adopting deep learning models to handle sentiment classification because of the advances that have been made. We present a framework named fastText along with Convolutional Neural Network in this study (CNN). To commence, we use fastText to create words vector representations that will be fed into the CNN. FastText’s purpose is to generate a generative model of a word as well as reflect word distance. This one will enable the parameters to also be established at an advantageous CNN point, which will help neural nets to perform much better in this circumstance. Second, we create a CNN architecture that is appropriate for sentiment analysis. We use two sets of convolutional layers along with pooling layers in this design. This is the first time, to our knowledge, that a 9-layer architecture and design model is developed based on fastText as well as CNN was used to assess the sentim ent of phrases. We use the Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU), Normalization, and Dropout techniques to improve the accuracy and generalizability of our model. We put our methodology to the test on a publicly available dataset of movie review extracts with five labels: negative, slightly negative, neutral, moderately positive, and positive. In this dataset, ourReLU pairwise network obtains a test accuracy of 96.4 percent, outperforming existing neural network models.

articleTitle: Quality of Services in Hybrid SDN (hSDN): A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: As now a day we see that internet has become the backbone of each and every digital society, smart devices as well as the growth of new technology and concepts like IOT, Machine learning 4G, 5G and social network that totally chanced all network requirement. In the last decade Software Define Networking (SDN) changed the Computer Network to an important and significant model as it composed of three different layer Data layer, Control layer and Application layer, main Idea behind SDN is separation of Control layer and Data layer and centralization of control layer to improve efficiency and performance in the network. As Software Define N has lots of benefit compare to legacy network but still deployment of pure SDN is not an easy work and it has its own limitation and some major challenges like financial challenge, technical challenge, security Issue, downtime fear of the network and quality of service degradation. These challenges slow down deployment of fully SDN and cause the birth of Hybrid Software Define Network (hSDN) which legacy devices coexist with SDN devices and take advantage of both legacy and Software Define Network robustness and programmability. In this paper we explore a review of Quality of services in Hybrid SDN in an approach which Quality of Service can benefit the most from the concept of Hybrid Software Define Network.

articleTitle: A Survey on Image Cryptosystems based on DNA Inspired Approaches
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The image data are large in size with highly correlated adjacent pixels. Therefore, the conventional data encryption technology is inadequate to effectively deal with such kind of data for ensuring their security. Deoxyribonucleic Acid (DNA) encryption is a frontal encryption technology as DNA molecule has a large data capacity, vast parallelism and has low ultra power requirement. Over the years, different image cryptosystems have been proposed with the use of DNA based encoding/ decoding and its sequential operations. The present paper provides an indepth analysis of the research carried out by different authors in the last decade uptill now as reported in the literature. It also provides a pathway for further research in the area.

articleTitle: Denoising Techniques in Healthcare Data for Improving Accuracy in Medical Applications – A Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Bigdata alludes to a huge assortment of information that keeps on expanding dramatically over the long run. Big data sources in health care incorporate patient medical records, clinic records, clinical test results, and data gathered by medical services testing machines. The main challenge associated with the health care data is the lack of accuracy, medical errors. This can be overcome by using big data so that the health care data can be denoised and accurate data can be obtained. This helps to enhance the efficiency of diagnosis of diseases. This review paper deals with various algorithms and denoising techniques which are used to enhance the accuracy of obtained health care data.

articleTitle: A Novel Stage Wise Denoising Approach on Ancient Kannada script from Rock Images
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Knowledge present in rocks is extincting due to degradation. So, the proposed work aims to binarize the historical ancient Kannada rock inscription from ancient temples about old slokas as well as mythological information’s in a readable format. The historical data are very precious so preserving such data is very important task. So proposed work makes the degraded rock inscriptions to readable format using the novel stage wise processing proceeded with smoothing, sharpening, noise removal, outlier detection, filling holes, background subtraction as well as thresholding. After thresholding will get a binarized output image which is more readable. The proposed research work has addressed some of the challenges like oil stains, rock erosion, algae, fungus and uneven illumination. Proposed model gives the highest accuracy of 95% compared to existing model like Otsu, Sauvola, Niblack, Adaptive Thersholding and Adaptive Gaussian Thersholding.

articleTitle: Rural Health Helper using NLP and IoT System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This system is a prototype through which the doctor can experience the patient current health from a collection of databases. The patient and the helper will be available where this system is implemented. The helper can monitor the temperature, pulse rate, and blood oxygen level in the LCD monitor through the real-time monitoring system. After the patient uses this IoT device, the device will monitor the patient’s health condition and update the health information into the connected system and it is stored in a database and generate the report. The website is used to communicate with the doctor which has the facility to upload the report update in the system using the IoT device and help is availed after the doctor views it. For overcoming the communication lag during this online consultation between the doctor and patient natural Language Processing is used.

articleTitle: Liver Failure Prediction using Supervised Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The liver’s activities include blood filtration, converting nutrients and medications ingested via the digestive system into necessary chemicals, and eliminating toxins and other chemical wastes from the blood. articleTitle: Translation of Multilingual Text into Speech for Visually Impaired Person
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Today’s human contact is primarily through voice and text. A person must have a proper vision to view and access the information available in the form of text. In any case, individuals who are blind can gather information by using their hearing ability. The proposed method is a camera-based assistive message reading system that allows blind people and travellers to read the E-messages, printed notes, and other materials in their native languages. It integrates the ideas of optical character recognition (OCR), text to voice synthesizer (TTS), and interpreter in the Raspberry Pi. The proposed model coverts the text from verified records or a caption overlay available on an image into machine-readable text. Text-to-Speech conversion has been enabled by employing the OCR operation to sweep and read any language characters and numbers present in an image and interpret the information in any desired language, and lastly produce a voice output of the decoded text. Voice is the output obtained through the Raspberry Pi’s sound jack, which may be heard by using speakers or headphones. The main goal of this research work is to develop and implement a novel model to transcribe the Text to Speech in many dialects.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of a Modified SMS4-BSK Cipher with Novel Efficient XOR Gate Design
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The SMS4-BSK cipher is a secure encryption algorithm that prevents data packets’ security threats over the wireless medium. In this paper, the novel design of a 4Transistor XOR gate structure is proposed. The SMS4-BSK cryptosystem is modified with this novel XOR gates by replacing the standard 12 Transistor XOR gates. Brute-force is an attack that can break any cipher by attempting all the combinations of the Key. The success of a cryptosystem design relies on how much time the brute-force attack takes to decode the secret information. In the defense sector, the cryptosystem should be designed so that it should be more vital to resist security attacks and be faster to encrypt the original message. The enciphering and deciphering process of the Modified SMS4-BSK algorithm uses the same keyspace. The same scheme can also be used for both enciphering and deciphering. The Modified SMS4-BSK algorithm is designed with Verilog HDL using the Xilinx Vivado Design and it is realized in 28nm Kintex-7 Field Programmable Gate Array. The implementation result shows that the delay of the Modified SMS4-BSK algorithm is 1.09 times lesser than the SMS4-BSK encryption architecture.

articleTitle: Online Sports Dance Body Contour Extraction and Training Algorithm based on DSP Chip Intelligent High-Definition Camera Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper studies the online sports dance human contour extraction and training algorithm based on DSP chip intelligent high-definition camera image processing. First, the gray image background difference method is used to obtain the human body region image; then the mathematical morphology method is used to repair the human body region image. processing; finally, extract the single-pixel human silhouette using the edge pixel neighborhood information. The characteristics and functions of special physical training are analyzed, from strength training, endurance training, speed training, flexibility training and coordination training, the real-time image processing system and the latest palmprint recognition principle are combined to form a handheld Palmprint recognition system.

articleTitle: Automated Pedestrian Opening by Weight Calculation and Sound Sensing based Traffic Light Control System for Pedestrian Safety
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper explains the real-life fact of pedestrian crossing and a small idea about enhancing the existing technology in the traffic light control system. This idea might be a changeover in helping the pedestrians to cross the road and would be a new start for implementing small and nano inventions into real life applications because tiny inventions are the key impetuses for the change in the development and prosperity of a country. This paper proposes an automated pedestrian opening system by weight calculation, and sound sensing based traffic light control system to let the emergency vehicles pass by. Moreover, this paper gives a detailed view of the existing technologies, and summarizes the advantages and disadvantages of the proposed system. The reason to choose the pedestrian crossing system is to reduce the traffic in both rural and urban cities. It helps a lot of people to save time and probably to reduce road accidents.

articleTitle: Drought Prediction and Water Quality Estimation using Satellite Images and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The earth faces various natural catastrophes such as drought. Drought impacts socio-economic development due to its timely occurrence and profound impacts. This even affects water bodies. There are various ways of predicting it like installing sensors in the soil, but this is not feasible as the entire soil cannot be entombed with sensors. Therefore, the vision is to use machine learning methodologies to predict drought and its severity by using satellite images. These data are temporal and spatial in nature. Data is acquired from Landsat 8 to assist with the drought prediction, soil moisture index is captured by Sentinel-1(SMAP). The Random Forest prediction model is used to predict drought and its severity. Furthermore, calculation of water quality using Chlorophyll-a as a primary parameter is also implemented. Drought has a severe impact on water quality as it affects the flow of nutrients in water bodies, increasing the amount of algae biomass in freshwater due to the increased temperature. Water quality uses Sentinel-2 to calculate indices contributing to water quality in the same region where severity of drought is calculated. The Random Forest drought prediction model gives high accuracy. The drought map on a region which is prone to drought was made using the prediction model which gave accurate results and the water quality estimator also showed degraded water bodies around that region. So, this model and estimator can be used to predict drought and prepare a mitigation plan not just for drought but also for the issue of water.

articleTitle: Classification of Anxiety in Human’s using Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: As already known, over the past decennium, mental health issues have become extremely common. The curve has been increasing exponentially over the past few years. In this fast-paced world, these problems are neglected, and they have become very common among the masses, which is increasing suicidal and self-harming thoughts. This paper will have a huge advantage as getting a test from this paper won't require an electrocardiogram (ECG) and electroencephalogram (EEG). This paper attempts to predict the psychological problems that occur. Further the occurrence of anxiety, depression, and other mental problems are predicted by mainly using three methods. Face emotion detection using a convolution neural network and how the strength of emotion makes our facial features change. FER-2013 database has been applied, speech emotion recognition where spectrogram is used and convolution neural network which consists mainly has three convolution layers and the fully connected layer to extract facial features and DASS-42 tool for the questionnaire series.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of Generic FIFO using Layered Test bench and Assertion Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The generic design of FIFO must undergo verification process for detection bugs occurred in system. This research process aims to develop FIFO by Verilog function. The verification process provide good quality product with low price value at time. This research process deployed with technique such as layered test bench and assertion technique. The parameters involved in FIFO are full, empty, last and second last first. The verification process is identified by layered test bench and assertion method. A design of this process would be complex to determine its read data to eradicate its resultant value evolved. This approach could be determined by raising positive and negative edges to manage system aspect.

articleTitle: Swarm Intelligence based Adaptation in Acoustic Echo Cancellation
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The echo and nonlinearity in voice conversations degrade the quality of voice in wired and wireless phone communication. The effect of nonlinear distortions in the echo path can be reduced by an adaptive filter which synthesizes a pattern of the non-linearity generated by the speaker and echo path. The proven superiority of Particle Swarm Optimization in the removal of nonlinearity in any optimization problem leads the selection of PSO as optimization algorithm to update the weights of Adaptive equalizer. To reduce the nonlinearities in the echo path effectively a careful inertia weight selection is done, and performance is validated through simulation results.

articleTitle: Supervision for Obscure Places to Avoid Intrusion using NNSA
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The primary objective of this research work is to prevent humans from entering the secured places. The proposed method is based on the Nearest Neighbor Searching Algorithm (NNSA) and SMTP Protocol. When the motion is detected, the captured image is sent to the authorized person through GCM technology, and an alarm is triggered to inform the surrounding neighbors. Finally, in order to avoid intrusion, the proposed solution provides the graphical images to the authorized user as well as neighbors.

articleTitle: Face Mask and Temperature Detection for Covid Safety using IoT and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Coronavirus Disease 2019(COVID-19), a global epidemic, has devastated society and taken many lives across the world. Many individuals have experienced anxiety, especially those who are used to being outside and having a lot of human interaction. The usage of a face mask and sanitizer remarkably reduces the transmission of the virus and in the same way, provides protection. The body temperature of an individual is also a strong indicator in determining an individual’s health. Still, it isn’t doable to manually track each person. The solution to this problem can be given through technology. This paper includes a deep learning system using open cv that can be able to detect cases where masks aren’t used duly and individuals whose body temperature is more than normal temperature using Raspberry Pi board. Further precautions can be taken by deploying a sanitizer dispenser and a mobile application that receives a text message. This model effectively monitors individuals, especially in crowded areas like theatres, schools, and working organizations.

articleTitle: Graph Neural Network based Recommender System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: With the rapid rise of online content, Recommender Systems are becoming increasingly important in reducing information overload. Because of the important technology worth of recommendation system, new studies on the subject have been published on a regular basis. The major difficulty in recommender systems is to create suitable user/item models using user activities as well as other data. Graph neural network techniques have lately become widely employed in recommender systems because most of the data is fundamentally graph architecture, and Graph Neural Network has advantage in graph supervised learning. This Paper aims to provide recent work done in the Graph Neural Network based recommender system. The paper also discusses the open issues and challenges pertaining to Graph Neural Network.

articleTitle: Auxiliary Code Automatic Generation Algorithm of Intelligent Art Platform Design Framework based on Visual 3D Information Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Auxiliary code automatic generation algorithm of intelligent art platform design framework based on visual 3D information modeling is designed and implemented in the paper. These rule-based methods synthesize natural language sentences directly from the code elements. They are the first successful methods of automatic annotation generation, which lays a foundation for the subsequent research. However, these methods lack portability and flexibility, and can only generate comments for specific code structures In addition, the number of keystrokes in the process of selecting and generating code can reflect the position of the code required by the programmer in the code recommendation list and the accuracy of the code generated by the automatic code generation tool. With these theoretical models, this paper then designs the novel intelligent art platform design framework based on visual 3D information modeling. The model is tested and compared and the performance is shown.

articleTitle: Disease Detection in Maize Plant using Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Maize is one of the most versatile crops. It has various types, used in many industrial processes and has wider adaptability under varied agro-climatic conditions. In 2020. a total of 145+ million metric tons of maize was produced by 160+ countries making it the second-most widely cultivated crop in the world.In 2020-21, India cultivated 30 million tonnes of maize. To meet this high demand, precision farming techniques are used for identifying, analysing and managing crop quality, helping generate optimum production as well as saving farming resources.One of the most significant reasons that affects crop output in India is the late detection of diseases in maize plants. This research will help in timely detection of such diseases and assist the farmers in the cultivation process, thus directly impacting maize production output. Maize plant leaf diseases like Leaf Blight. Leaf Spots, and Leaf Rust have clear cut symptoms that can be visually identified. Thus such diseases can be identified and their classification can be done using Artificial Intelligence. In image classification and pattern recognition, Deep Convolutional Neural Networks are known to have higher efficiency and accuracy. Hence it can be used as a potent tool in the diagnosis of maize plant diseases. Thus, this research work has proposed a Deep Convolution Neural Network model which combines with Transfer Learning technique, resulting in reduced training time taken by the AI model. For higher accuracy acquisition, Data Augmentation techniques are used to improve upon the variability in the dataset that is being used to train the network. This model that has been put forward achieved an accomplished accuracy of 97.93%.Attaining a greater accuracy is really vital for the amelioration of present crop wastage conditions due to diseases that are left undetected. This accuracy can even be increased by adding some other parameters about which will be discussed in future works section.

articleTitle: PeerConnect: Live Virtual Event Platform by using Web Server
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Peerconnect is a great solution for virtual event management. Peerconnect is an all-in-one event management platform for promoting and conducting online events on the same platform. The point of virtual event management software is to allow users to create hosts and manage the events at ease without having to depend on many software to accomplish different tasks. So, the event management software Peerconnect has established the pipeline for people who want to promote, manage and conduct virtual events. Organizers can create the events on the platform and can promote and sell the tickets to other users on the same platform. Organizers can host live chat rooms and live discussions with video calling capabilities as well. Peerconnect is a web application using which the user can get to know about the events which are conducted virtually. Once the user selects the event, then he has to register for it. Once the registration is successful, user can attend the event on the same platform. Once the registration is successful, users can successfully login and they can search for an event that they are interested in and filter them according to their interests. Once the user selects the event then they have to register for it. Once registration for the event is successful, user can join the event in just one click and attend the event on the same platform and can download the participation certificate as well. If a registered user misses an event, he can still watch the recorded session of that event anytime after its completion. The event organizer can create an organization and later post the event. During the event, the organizer can send files and use the chat feature to engage and clear doubts of the attendees. They can also share their screen so that it is visible to all the attendees. Organizers can also capture the attendance of those who are attending, based on which the attendees can be able to download their participation certificates.

articleTitle: Automatic Noise Class Detection For Improving Speech Quality Using Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Speech quality degrades in noisy environments while using a particular voice over internet protocol (VoIP) application, for example, Microsoft Skype, Apple Facetime, etc. Speech enhancement algorithms separate noise from the degraded speech. No-reference speech quality metric (SQM), such as P.563, measures the quality of speech. To this end, this research study develops a novel approach for extracting features from the noisy speech samples available from the NOIZEUS corpus for detecting the noise class (noise type and SNR) using deep neural network (DNN). It integrates speech enhancement algorithms with SQM to estimate the speech quality (MOS score) from the noisy samples, which is then used as a feature vector to train a DNN. Results demonstrate that the DNN outperforms in detecting the noise class as compared to the machine learning classifiers, tested with different noise classes. This suggests to develop a noise-sensitive speech quality prediction model for real-time measuring and monitoring of the quality of speech.

articleTitle: A Traffic-Aware and Power-Saving base Station Switch off Method for Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: With rapid surge in the number of mobile devices (MDs), demand for more data rates is increasing day by day. Providing connectivity to MDs and to meet the demand for high data rates under tremendous traffic is a bottleneck. To meet the demand for call connectivity and quality data services, there is a need to have more number of base stations (BSs) in a given area. In metropolitan areas, the distribution of load on these increased BSs drastically changes, since the MDs movement is highly dynamic and is a function of time. This heavily impacts the efficiency of the BSs due to non-uniform traffic at different times of the day which can be overcome by switching off a BS having low traffic and allocating the already connected MDs to its neighboring BSs. In this paper, we propose an efficient MD allocation model that continuously monitors the traffic across all the BSs in a cluster to switch off, identifies the BSs with traffic below some predefined threshold, and switches the MDs in these BSs to the neighboring base stations. Simulation results show a comprehensive improvement in power efficiency of the cellular network.

articleTitle: MATLAB Simulation Research on Harmonic Elimination Algorithm of Active Power Filter Based on Cascaded Multilevel Inverter Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: MATLAB simulation research on the Harmonic elimination algorithm of active power filter based on cascaded multilevel inverter technology is conducted in the paper. After obtaining the signal in the two-phase stationary coordinate system through coordinate transformation, sector judgment is then carried out to synthesize three basic vectors of the reference voltage vector. Then perform time calculation to determine the action time of the three basic vectors, that is, the duty cycle. In the actual measurement of non-sinusoidal periodic signals, it is generally used in a continuous period of time to then make the voltage signal undergo analog-to-digital conversion to obtain a discrete time signal represented by a finite word length, and intercept a period from it to calculate the harmonics of each order with the amplitude of the wave. Through the MATLAB, the proposed model is simulated. The designed model is proven to be efficient.

articleTitle: Emotion Recognition using Images in Android device
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Emotion is an important component of human existence. Since interpersonal human communication not only includes verbal communication but also nonverbal indicators. According to studies, more than half of communication is dependent on nonverbal indicators such as body language and facial emotions, which are difficult to conceal since they are considered as involuntary responses. Due to these factors, emotion detection is considered as a broad field of study with numerous real-world implications, which can promote widespread social interactions.

articleTitle: Novel Smart Frame of Computer-aided Clothing Design Algorithm based on Camera Image Positioning
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Novel smart frame of the computer-aided clothing design algorithm based on camera image positioning is studied in the paper. Before making an interior floor plan, it is necessary to fully consider the basic principles of the interior floor plan information processing and design, as well as layer information layering processing technology. Therefore, the QR code can be attached to each important physical identification or other key location through QR code technology. When viewing the physical identification system, users can access the indoor plan oriented identification system by scanning the QR code through their mobile phone. In this paper, a rectangular frame can be used to represent all the foreground information of the human body. The upper edge of the rectangular frame can approximately represent the head position of the human body, and the lower edge of the rectangular frame can replace the foot position of the human body. Then, we optimizet hesoftware to provide the efficient analysis.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Interactive System for Economic Management Computer Simulation Laboratory based on Python Structured Module
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Design of the intelligent interactive system for economic management computer simulation laboratory based on Python structured module is presented in the paper. The development language of the intelligent information operation and maintenance management platform chooses Python. The main reason for choosing the Python language is that it is simple, fast and flexible, commonly known as “glue language”. The application of the Python scripting language to web crawler design has its unique advantages. Scraping is an automatic web crawler framework developed and packaged based on Python language, through which directional data crawling can be performed. Based on these technique innovation, this paper gives the novel understanding of the intelligent interactive system for economic management computer simulation laboratory based on Python structured module. The simulation has proven the general performance.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection of Imbalanced Network Traffic
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: With the growth of the Internet, cyber-attacks are evolving at a rapid pace, and the cyber security scenario is bleak. Machine and Deep Learning approaches for intrusion detection network analysis, as well as a brief instructional overview of each Machine Learning/Deep Learning method. Using temporal or temperature correlations, those presenting each approach were summarized. They cover some of the most often used datasets in Machine learning, highlight the limitations of employing these algorithms for cyber security, and offer future opportunities because data is so crucial in these methodologies. There is a lot of effort being done to enhance intrusion detection algorithms, but study into the information to train & test the model is important since higher data quality can improve offline intrusion detection. The study examines the KDD data set in terms of four classes: Basic, Content, Traffic, and Host, with all data characteristics being classified using MODIFIED RANDOM FOREST (MRF). For Intrusion Detection System (IDS), the analysis is done using two popular assessments metrics: Detection Rate (DR) and False Alarm Rate (FAR). The influence of each of four classes of qualities on DR and FAR is displayed as per the output based on data.

articleTitle: Cross-Layer DoS Attack Detection Technique for Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Security of Internet of Things (IoT) is one of the most prevalent crucial challenges ever since. The diversified devices and their specification along with resource constrained protocols made it more complex to address over all security need of IoT. Denial of Service attacks, being the most powerful and frequent attacks on IoT have been considered so forth. However, the attack happens on multiple layers and thus a single detection technique for each layer is not sufficient and effective to combat these attacks. Current study focuses on cross layer intrusion detection system (IDS) for detection of multiple Denial of Service (DoS) attacks. Presently, two attacks at Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) and Routing Protocol are considered for Low power and Lossy Networks (RPL) and a neural network-based IDS approach has been proposed for the detection of such attacks. The attacks are simulated on NetSim and detection and the performance shows up to 80% detection probabilities.

articleTitle: Investigation of Pilot Decontamination Algorithm in Multicell Massive MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Pilot Contamination occurs when the same pilot sequence is used again in conjoining cells, which is a serious problem that must be addressed. A Hybrid scheme utilized for Pilot decontamination that unite two pilot decontamination schemes namely the Soft pilot reuse scheme and Weighted-Graph-Colored Pilot Decontamination Scheme is studied in this paper. The performance of the above mentioned hybrid decontamination strategy with respect to the varying number of antennas and pilot Sequences that was not presented in previous works is investigated. The outcome of simulation show that increasing the number of Base station antenna and pilot sequences improves the performance of the standalone decontamination schemes. It is comparatively better than the combinational SPRS + WGC-PD, which uses fewer Base station antennas and pilot sequences.

articleTitle: IoT based Rainfall Surveillance System with Sensor Integrated Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The IoT - Internet of Things is essential in a diversity of sectors. The highest rainfall afflicts most places in the winter period of each year. As a result, climate and other ecological and environmental catastrophes must be monitored. The primary goal of our system is to propose an IoT-based automatic weather system to give farmers an idea about whether cultivating or harvesting crops would have been profitable and to avoid and notify disasters. The system suggested in this paper offers a way to track weather patterns precisely and make the data obtainable to any person in the world. The Internet of Items (IoT) is the innovation behind all this, a cost-efficient solution for linking devices to the internet and linking the entire universe in a network. Temperature, Humidity, Rain Drop, Pressure, Light Intensity, and other sensors were used extensively in this architecture. Other relevant variables, such as the dew point is determined with the assistance of humidity and temperature. The data updated by the established system is available on the internet and may be accessed from anywhere. In MATLAB, the system design topology was implemented. The units are linked to the laptop and have been extensively examined in a software development environment.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of Bayesian classifier with GLCM features on Digital X-ray images
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The Bayesian classifier has proved efficient classification rate with many features. This paper focus on the analyzing the performance of Bayesian classifier over Grey Level Co-Occurrence Matrix (GLCM) features. A total of 130 digital -x ray images were used for the study. The performance metrics was evaluated using statistical parameters. The motive of the study is estimating the best fit in development of machine learning algorithm for diagnosis of Osteoarthritis

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Networks based Voice Assistive System for Blind People
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Over 285 million individuals worldwide are blind, either completely or partially, and they face numerous challenges in detecting obstacles around them. As a result, this prototype develops the concept of supplying them with a simple and cost-effective solution via artificial vision. This procedure entails collecting an image of the object with a high-resolution camera, and then using open computer vision to offer a frame of work on the image and detect it. After that, using the Convolution Neural Network (CNN) technique, the taken image is processed and compared to the dataset provided. It is labelled after being compared to the dataset, and the speaker broadcasts the voice at the same time with the distance between the object and user that is initiated by the ultrasonic sensor. By following the steps outlined above, a very efficient system that is solely focused on aiding blind individuals has been created. As a result, the proposed approach enables blind users to manage unaware indoor and outdoor locations.

articleTitle: Driver’s Safety Management System for Commercial Purposes using IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A low-cost and simple distributed sensors model that is particularly suitable for measuring eye blink of the driver, accident and hand position on a steering wheel. These sensors can be used in automotive active safety systems that aim at detecting driver’s fatigue, a major issue to prevent road accidents. The key point of this approach is to design a prototype of sensor units, so that it can serve as platform for integrating different kinds of sensors into the steering wheel. Since the sensors are attached to the steering wheel, therefore they can’t be detached by the driver. It will also detect dangerous stylish driving which may lead to fatal accidents. To avoid the accidents made by drivers during drowsiness the eye blinker system gets notified and buzzer get alert to the driver who driving. And helps to wake the driver to concentrate in his ride to avoid accident. And the alcohol detector uses to detect the driver who drunk and drive the car to avoid accident the sensor is more usable and after the detection of the alcohol consumed by the driver the car steering get vibrated and intimate the driver to sudden stop to avoid accident zone. And the GPM and GPRS sensor used to send the alcohol consumed to the owner of the car and to take action immediately. And drivers like UBER, OLA acting drivers can be cautious to drive the vehicle and make more comfortable to the passenger

articleTitle: CPW-Fed Circular Shaped Patch Antenna with Minkowski Fractal DGS using Flexible Substrate for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A circular shaped microstrip patch antenna etched with split square shape fed by a Grounded Coplanar Waveguide (GCPW) is implemented in this paper, with this much broader bandwidth has secured with appreciable reflection coefficient values compared to the antennas with flexible designs. In the presented design, flexible material kapton is used as a substrate with a ratio of substance permittivity to the free space permittivity known as relative permittivity ε<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf>, which is equal to 3.4 and tanδ equal to 0.002, which denotes electrical energy dissipation. Furthermore, to the split square-shaped slot on the patch, the designed antenna has Minkowski fractal shaped slots over all the corners of the ground as DGS (Defected Ground Structure). This design provides compactness and a good reflection coefficient at targeted frequency bands. The overall size of the antenna is 30 X 26 X 0.09 mm^3. Without Minkowski fractal slots over the ground, the proposed antenna design provides dual resonating frequencies with narrow bandwidth at 2.94 GHz and 3.82 GHz. Through the concept of Minkowski fractal slots as DGS and CPW feeding technique, wider impedance bandwidth at the frequency of 3.52GHz is about 634.79MHz (19.16%) with a reflection coefficient of - 37.34dB and VSWR of 1.027 achieved. The Initiated antenna design simulated by employing the software CST Microwave studio.

articleTitle: Building IoT-Assisted Indoor Air Quality Pollution Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Air pollution causes several diseases like suffocation, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), lung cancer, throat infection, and so forth. So, there is a need to monitor indoor air quality for the safety of human life. Indoor air pollution is even more dangerous than outdoor air pollution. Even, after the COVID-19 pandemic, humans are spending most of their time in indoor houses. In addition to this, air pollution is increasing day by day due to varying climate changes. In view of this fact, this research wor has designed and developed a novel system based on the latest IoT technology that monitors indoor air quality and provides a web portal for data visualization. The proposed system consists of several gas sensors integrated on a single PCB that helps in reading seven pollutants like CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, CO, O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, VOC, and Particulate Matter along with humidity and temperature. In our work, Raspberry Pi acts as a processor as well as the communicating node to the cloud. The experimental setup is deployed in several indoor places like closed labs, classrooms, homes, etc., where humans spend more time. Raspberry Pi is having an inbuilt wi-fi functionality and the real-time data is sent to Google Firebase with help of a Jio Fi router. After visualizing the data, Indoor Air Quality Index (IAQI) is measured and generates an alarm for the safety of humans when air standard crosses a marginal value.

articleTitle: Automatic Generation of Ancient Food Culture Image Series based on Virtual Imaging Algorithm and Design of Intangible Cultural Heritage Smart Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Automatic generation of the ancient food culture image series based on virtual imaging algorithm and design of intangible cultural heritage platform is studied in the paper. Because the laser image is blurred due to the noise interference brought by the equipment and improper operation in the process of dynamic laser image acquisition, this paper mainly implements noise reduction and splicing processing for the collected dynamic laser image to improve the quality of laser virtual imaging, so as to improve the accuracy of three-dimensional dynamic image reconstruction based on laser virtual imaging. It can be seen from the definition of basic operations of grayscale morphology that the essence of dilation and erosion is to use structural elements as sliding filter windows to search for the grayscale maximum or minimum value of the image in the window. Then, with these theoretical innocation, the designed intangible cultural heritage smart platform is then implemented. Through the core testing, the performance is tested.

articleTitle: Application of 2D Dynamic Graphics based on Registration Algorithm in Computer Graphic Design
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Application of 2D dynamic graphics based on the registration algorithm in computer graphic design is discussed in the paper. Any complex component can be regarded as an entity reorganized from a part of a simple basic body through the overlapping, dividing and other modes. Drawing a real view is a key part of drawing. Reading a drawing is to deduce the spatial shape and structure of the entity through the analysis of the shape and the projection interpretation of the line and surface through the plane image that has been drawn. Dynamic graphics in digital media can be divided into three categories: two-dimensional plane graphics, three-dimensional graphics and also imitative three-dimensional representation of two-dimensional graphics. We consider the proper combinations of the different models to construct the efficient model.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-based Short Term Wind Speed Prediction of Aeroelastic Model
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Generally, the performance and motion of wind turbines is dependent on speed prediction. In particular, predicting the wind speed improves the pitch activity, and extreme gusts may become defective before reaching the turbine. To avoid the consequences of the irregularities, appropriate actions must be taken. Wind prediction has two stages: estimation and prediction. An extended Kalman filter is designed to estimate the turbine. This extended Kalman filter is developed by using a three-dimensional non-linear rotor model. Prediction, extrapolation, and machine learning all goes through two different performance stages. The proposed methodology is practically experienced by using the data attained from a hi-fi aeroelastic version.

articleTitle: Face Verification Component for Offline Proctoring System using One-shot learning
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Historically Deep learning algorithms like Face Recognition do not work well on One-shot learning tasks. Hence, we need algorithms that can learn information about objects from one, or a few, training examples or images. In addition to that, if any new class is introduced to the model, there will be requirement to train it from beginning. We solve these problems by using the weights of a pre-trained model. The goal of this project is to use the concept of one-shot learning to create a component for an offline proctoring system. This system is foolproof against seat-swapping and it is also resilient to different lighting conditions and poses. In this project, we have used a pre-trained siamese network model and have established the feasibility of the product on a number of metrics including the accuracy of the model under different conditions like change in orientation and lighting.

articleTitle: Effect Evaluation Algorithm of College Sports Intelligent Interactive System Under the Background of Multi-Level Data Convolution
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: By making full use of the characteristics of middle and high-level convolutional features for combined similarity measurement, the accuracy and robustness of closed-loop detection are improved. Since the dimension of the convolutional feature vector is particularly large, the convolutional feature vector is firstly subjected to dimensionality reduction processing. The use of smart classroom and cloud teaching mode under big data has launched an important educational reform in physical education teaching in colleges and universities in my country, and the Apriori algorithm has been improved to reduce the time and space complexity. The improved association rules method is used to mine frequent itemsets in the sports process of college sports teaching. Experiments show that the experiments on Tokyo 24/7 datasets confirm the feasibility and effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Bio Inspired Meta Heuristic Approach based on Red Deer in WSN
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This article evaluates a new optimal solution motivated by Red Deer. Red Deer is one of the population based algorithm which can be used in various applications The unexpected mating habits of Red Deer is investigated in sequence in the development of an optimal solution. The method begins with a conmunity of individuals Also, the individuals known as Red Deer are split into two categories: hinds and men Red Deer, who establish harems together. Harem is a collection of women who mate with the harem’s leader. The suggested population-based algorithm is based on men Red Deer fight to obtain a harem with more hinds Only men Red Deer will reach the finals using their talents such as shouting and fighting during this battle. They are willing to accept a concession coupling that includes a percentage of hinds It will be competitive with other men Red Deer since it can develop different options and choose the best one The algorithm can be used for solving number of optimization problems in WSN like coverage hole, hole restoration etc.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Different hand gestures Detection and Recognition Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Hand Gesture is a wide technology aspect of computer Science. It provides a good technology tool for human computer interaction. With some mathematical algorithms, Humans can interact with computers without using any mechanical devices. Also for deaf and mute people, communication hindrance can be remediate. Hand gesture is the most expressive and frequent among any type of expression language. It can put up sign language recognition to a new level. This paper is oriented towards a comparative analysis of different types of hand gesture Detection and recognition methods. In addition, the result and problems with different approaches are tabulated. These have different gesture types and so different number of gesture classes. Most of these methods produce accuracy of 90-95%. The best accuracy achieved for static hand gestures is 95.7% which is based on the ML algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimization of Energy in Wireless Sensor Network Using Leach Protocol
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Low-powered Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) have a significant problem in terms of sensor node energy utilisation. To balance network energy consumption and lengthen the life cycle, the improved protocol was constructed on a low-power adaptive cluster location. (LEACH) is a concept that has been proposed. This paper proposes a method for optimising the routing protocol. To reduce the chance of excessive cluster head dispersion, the first variation of cluster head is laboured out similar to the general energy consumption consistent with round. As a result of our effort, the energy usage for transporting tasted data from the sensor deployment location to the base station has been reduced. Cluster heads collect data from detectors in the cluster and total it in the LEACH process. Data that has been aggregated is also useful. Both simple consumer electronic gadgets and complicated space technology are examples of how these networks work. The low-energy versatile bunching scale convention is utilized to work on the exhibition of the WSNs knocks regarding power utilization.
