The viability of a remote organization can be impacted by an assortment of elements, including the size of the WSN and the first energy of the locator hitch. This could urge scholastics to make the best design for WSNs to give the required usefulness. The impact of the indicator bunch’s unique energy and the WSN size on the quantity of running knocks is investigated in this exploration utilizing MATLAB to examine the presentation of the low-energy versatile grouping scale convention.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Parity Preserving Flip-Flops Using Parity Preserving Gates by Quantum Cellular Automata and Verilog
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The proposed research study has designed parity preserving FFs using parity preserving gates like FREDKIN gate (FRG) and FEYNMAN gate (FYG) using Quantum Cellular Automata (QCA). Incognitive property of reversible logic attracts most researchers where energy dissipation is a big concern. The complexity of parity reversible circuits is better than simple reversible circuits. The proposed models of the FF(FF) are way superior to the existing designs with regards to constant input, quantum cost, gate count, area, power dissipation, garbage output, and delay. The characteristics of the proposed FF are compared with the existing characteristics of the FF. It shows that the performance of QCA has increased by 24%, 28%, and 37.5% in terms of area and 55%, 62%, and 68% in terms of delay of our proposed D, T, and JK FFs respectively.

articleTitle: Two-phase feature extraction with chi square-based feature selection approach for the classification of online product reviews
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: As Internet technology progresses, users are increasingly opting for online shopping. Users can now not only purchase items but also offer feedback on their satisfaction with them. In terms of enhancing product quality, these reviews are incredibly valuable to both the user and the vendor. It becomes challenging to manually process a large amount of review data that is increasing in volume, subjectivity, and heterogeneity. To address this issue, machine learning (ML) technologies have been used in real-world applications, although there are still many hurdles. In order to achieve a more accurate result, this research study has used a mix of many fundamental machine learning techniques. Two-phase feature Extraction is used with chi square-based feature selection (FS) to reduce the dimension of the data. Three Ensamble classifiers were utilised, which merged several basic classifiers to choose the best outcome. The suggested model is tested using a dataset of 74000 product reviews from two well-known e-commerce sites, Flipkart and Amazon. And the model produces the most accurate results, with a 98% accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Automatic Pressure Monitoring and Pipeline Protection for Irrigation
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: As India is one of the Agro-based countries, most of the water resources are depleting by means of inefficient irrigation methods. In addition to this, farmers' negligence in operating irrigation systems has led to the damage of irrigation systems. In this work, we have created a prototype to prevent system damage due to overpressure and make the farmer aware of the issue. The pressure sensor is installed at the outlet and continuously monitors the pressure. The Arduino collects the data from the digital pressure sensor and converts it into pressure value and displays it on the LCD. The saturated value can be set using a keypad and when the measured pressure value exceeds the saturated value, it cut off the supply power to the motor using a contactor. The contactor is controlled using a relay drive. This system protects the irrigation system from damage and prevents the wastage of cost and water.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Guidance Algorithm for Language Training in Cross-cultural Communication based on Multicast Multimedia Fusion SSD Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: At the end of each cycle, the optimal solution is retained, the volatility coefficient is changed adaptively, and the crossover operator of the genetic algorithm is introduced. A delay-constrained multicast routing algorithm model based on ACO is proposed. Detection (SSD) framework, SSD network uses multi-layer feature maps (FeatureMaps) for target prediction, in which the shallower feature layer needs to obtain both low-level features and high-level semantic features. The design of intelligent guidance algorithm for language training in cross-cultural communication is studied. Realizing the transformation from “content provision” to “network hub” will help the international dissemination of Chinese culture and improve dissemination efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of Distributed Studio System for College English online Courses based on OSI Model: from Data Dissemination to Information Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Design of distributed studio system for college English online courses based on the OSI model from data dissemination to information mining is studied in the paper. The structure and decentralized characteristics of the distributed network enhance the flexibility and scalability of the network. When a single node in the network fails, the impact on the overall system is relatively small. Considering these features, the novel distributed studio system considering OSI is designed. The transport layer provides reliable end-to-end, process to process datagram interaction and error recovery to the high level in the network layer. The role of session layer is to establish sessions, manage sessions and terminate sessions when necessary. Then, this structure is applied into the application of the college English online course systems. Through the testing, the data dissemination towards information mining is tested to be efficient.

articleTitle: Multi-Dimensional Measurement and Analysis Platform for Modern Guiding Value Mining in Smart Sports Classroom based on Camera Array Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Multi-dimensional measurement and analysis platform for modern guiding value mining in smart sports classroom based on camera array technology is the primary topic of this study. In terms of geometric model optimization, the method of constructing internal and external error compensation models separately and solving them as a whole can achieve certain results in the local scene or adjacent scene images. To better analyze the collected image, the novel CCD image model is designed. Using the anisotropic Gaussian directional derivative filter can effectively extract the characteristics of grayscale changes at the corners, and adopting a multi-directional strategy can detect corners more accurately. With this idea, the platform for modern guiding value mining in smart sports classroom is considered as the sample application. Comparing with the other state-of-the-art models, the designed approach is efficient.

articleTitle: Term Preterm Delivery Classification with Electro Hysterogram and Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Preterm birth is regarded as one of the major causes of new-born illness and death. It not only creates a physical trauma but also a big mental trauma, especially to the new mother who has gone through a lot of changes throughout her body and mind. Although there are many diagnostic tools available for the early identification of preterm deliveries, many risks are associated with those and sometimes they fail to detect whether the delivery would happen as preterm or not. No chance can be taken by following invasive methods for introspection. After analysing different non-invasive methods, using Electro hysterogram, external recording of the uterine muscular activities is spotted as a great tool in detection of early birth. EHG measures the electrical activity of uterine muscle cells so is linked to the powerful contractions that occur during pregnancy. Combining this technique of acquiring EHG signals along with the Machine learning concepts makes the detection easier. Here, this research work presents a classification based on this approach using ten different classifiers and has arrived at a conclusion based on their performances.

articleTitle: Phonoarthrography for Early Detection of Osteoarthritis using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: When the constituents of a joint move within their range of motion, they brush against each other, creating friction and therefore noises. To make an accurate diagnosis, the phono arthrography (PAG) technique involves detecting, recording, and analyzing sounds. This non-invasive approach could be an alternative to arthroscopy or X-rays, which are currently employed. In terms of diagnosing disorders such as osteoarthritis, it has been shown to be as accurate as existing approaches (OA). Although the PAG approach is still in progress, it exhibits excellent accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity when comparing findings from the healthy and nonspecific knee-related problem groups. The multiclass classification, on the other hand, is hardly unknown. As a result, the goal of the research is to expand the PAG methodology classification to five groups based on diverse patellofemoral joint problems.

articleTitle: A Linearly Polarized Microstrip Antenna for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper presents a simple microstrip patch antenna has been operated in ka - frequency band with the inset feed and etched with two circular shapes with different radius to improve the antenna performance at 27.5GHz for 5G applications. FR4 substrate is used as a substrate which has dielectric constant of 4.4 with height 1.6mm. The designed antenna is simulated using High Frequency Structured Simulator (HFSS). Return loss, gain, bandwidth, and voltage standing wave ratio can be obtained. The simulated model provides the return loss of <-10dB, VSWR ≤2 and a very good bandwidth. Moreover, the dimensions of the antenna reduced drastically and the antenna efficiency has been improved.

articleTitle: Analysis of anisotropic wireless sensor network’s range-free localization techniques based on salps swarm algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Node localization in a wireless sensor network (WSN) seeks to compute the positions of unknown nodes (regular node) using known nodes(anchor nodes). The accuracy with which a WSN is located can have a substantial influence on its performance. Most standard range-free localization techniques disregard anisotropic considerations in real-time wireless sensor applications, resulting in low localization accuracy. To increase localization accuracy in the target area, bio-inspired algorithms will aid in the optimization of expected placements of unknown sensor nodes. The reliable anchor pairing approach and the salps swarm algorithm (SSA) in traditional range-free localization methods like the DV-Hop method are used to mitigate anisotropic factors. Particle swarm optimization (PSO) and grey wolf optimization (GWO) and other well-known optimization methods are compared to the proposed algorithm under different WSN topologies.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis Platform for Utilization Benefit of College Gymnasiums based on Hierarchical Sensor Data Analysis and Video Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Comprehensive analysis platform forutilization benefit of college gymnasiums based on hierarchical sensor data analysis and video surveillance is designed and implemented in the paper. The panoramic image adopts cylindrical projection method, which can display the scene with wide field of view. However, because the cylindrical projection display method is designed to display large field of view or panoramic image, which is different from ideal small hole imaging, the cylindrical display has distortion, that is, the image of the target area has bending deformation. With this idea, the hierarchical sensor data analysis and video surveillance are combined for the estimation. The designed model is then applied to the platform forutilization benefit of college gymnasiums. Through the simulation, the complex testing is conducted to show the performance.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Multi-Port Video Team Collaboration Hardware in Classroom Teaching Intelligent Guidance System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper designs the hardware circuit of multi-video acquisition and multi-video group cooperation, including signal amplification circuit, analog-to-digital conversion circuit, video information buffer circuit, video display digital-to-analog conversion circuit, interface hardware circuit, etc., and realizes the digitalization of image information acquisition. As well as the simulation of image information display, the H.264 standard is used to edit the video data by MFC hardware encoding; the system designs a video processing module, through the improvement of the pedestrian detection algorithm, from the academic arrangement, academic guidance, academic The five levels of monitoring, academic diagnosis and academic improvement realize an all-round intelligent guidance system and form a personalized academic guidance model.

articleTitle: Prospect of Intelligent English Translation Algorithm based on Neural Machine Translation and Internal Chain Network Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Prospect of the intelligent English translation algorithm based on the neural machine translation and internal chain network modeling is studied in the paper. Due to the limitation of the scale of thesaurus, neural network translation models often cannot deal with the translation of people's names well, which is prone to missing translation or wrong translation, and the translation quality of people's names often has a great impact on the quality of the final translation. The preprocessing of bilingual corpus in machine translation is a prerequisite for obtaining good translations. In order to enable the neural network to better learn the semantic information in the bilingual corpus and the contextual relationship of each word, high-quality word segmentation is particularly important. Hence, with the integration of the neural machine translation and deep neural network, this research work has designed and developed an intelligent English translation algorithm. Through the experimental analysis, the simulations are conducted and comparison analysis is presented.

articleTitle: Detection of Face Mask using AI
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this situation, wearing a face mask is crucial since it protects us from the virus and prevents it from spreading. In this situation, though, some people are forgetting to use a mask, allowing the sickness to spread quickly. A face mask detector is needed to determine whether or not someone is wearing a mask, especially in public locations. As well known, the world is now experiencing a covid pandemic, thus the WHO (Global Health Organization) and world governments have implemented a number of measures to prevent the virus from spreading, one of which is wearing a face mask. Additional safeguards include sanitation, immunization, and social seclusion etc.

articleTitle: Design of Intimacy Degree based on Short-range Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: With the growing demand for contact density between people in public safety, applications for person-to-person contact information collection based on intelligent sensing networks have gradually emerged and developed. According to the physical interpersonal interaction will have the characteristics of location proximity and time stay, the information exchange by radio becomes a common medium for collecting contact point recorded. In this paper, we design a method of computing contact frequency of people based on Bluetooth 5.0 low-power beacon sending and receiving to obtain the location distance of people by exchanging identity data and measuring signal intensity; we propose the XS -V intimacy degree algorithm for the characteristics of multilateral data exchange such as time duration, region aggregating degree, and strange point coincidence; we use the filtering technique of XS-V unusual point to greatly improve the correct recognition rate of approaching the effective points. The experimental test shows that the proposed method of recording contact frequency of people based on Bluetooth low-power beacon sending and receiving is accurate in judging intimacy points, has high discrimination of intimacy degree values, and can complete quantitative recording of intimacy degree for contact points 2–50 within 10s.

articleTitle: Web based Feedback Supervision System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Feedback is a valuable information covering the internal activity, progress and processes of an organization which leads to a better work environment, encourages innovation, and helps in increasing productivity. Feedback maybe given for an individual’s performance or performance of a team or regarding the performance of a company. It provides a sense of engagement and interactivity which allows them to know their current position and also know what is needed to achieve the higher level. It promotes personal and professional growth. Top performing organisations are top performing because they are in constant search for ways to improve and make their best even better. This project is to create a web application for companies and corporates to store, handle, manage and update the feedback of employees and clients and also to provide feedback to its employees and record all feedback in a database. By implementing this web-based system, all employees’ feedback and feedback given to the employees can be managed efficiently and this will make documentation easier. This will help in creating a feedback culture at the workplace irrespective of his place in the organisational chart.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Dynamic Communication Network in the Development of the Visualization Platform of Sanquan Guiding Model from the Perspective of Data Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Application of computer dynamic communication network in the development of the visualization platform of the Sanquan Guiding Model from the perspective of data structure is studied in the paper. In the designed model, after the route summarization is performed on the area border router, even if the topology structure in the area changes, the changed link state information will not be propagated to area 0, so that OSPF routers in other areas do not have to interpret their own routes. The table is updated to improve the stability of the network. Then, the computer dynamic communication network in the development of the visualization platform is implemented with the node data optimization steps. Then, the applications and the tests are bioth discussed.

articleTitle: Multi-level Optimization of Shared Cloud Architecture for Computer-Supported Sports Collaborative Learning Experiment Scenario
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Multi-level optimization of the shared cloud architecture for the computer-supported sports collaborative learning experiment scenario is studied in the paper. Incremental checkpointing can also reduce the size of the checkpoint file, thereby reducing the overhead of saving checkpoints. The implementation of incremental checkpoints relies on a runtime monitor. If the monitor finds that a certain storage area has not been modified since the last checkpoint during a checkpoint, it will be ignored in the current checkpoint. This memory area can reduce the size of the current checkpoint file. IaaS cloud computing platform mainly provides users with basic resource services in three aspects: computer, storage, and network. Hence, with this model, the designed optimization of shared cloud architecture for the computer-supported sports collaborative learning experiment scenario is demonstrated. Through the experimental results, the performance is validated.

articleTitle: Swarm Behaviour Classification Using LSTM and Deep neural networks
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Swarm behaviour was first simulated in 1986 and the agents are made to have motion per some basic rules. Swarm intelligent systems consists of simple agents known as boids, boids is an artificial program simulating the flocking behaviour of birds, these boids interact with one another and with their environment. Efforts are made to use results and observations of swarm intelligence to solve practical problems.As the behaviour is resembled to different classes of birds,insects etc hence the classification is necessary that what kind of swarm is it based on the features that are collected and doing all the processes. The artificial Intelligence concept can be used in the classification and the behaviour of it needs to be classified as the end output. The main motive of the paper that has been defined by the authors is to use LSTM which is a kind of recurrent neural network along with deep neural network and find a novel accuracy and after it compare the models based on different metrics.

articleTitle: Software Based Solution for Efficient Energy Utilization of an IoT Node PSoC6-Dual Core Using a Scheduler
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Embedded systems are an integral part of today’s time with a wide range of specific applications. Increasing design requirements has emphasized the need to focus on sectors such as power consumption, flexibility, cost, performance, and robustness. Power consumption is the major issue in embedded systems that needs to be addressed to sustain long term functionality of the devices. PSoC 6 MCU is a System-on-chip, specifically designed for Internet of Things with enhanced computation and communication capabilities. However, the task to be executed on dual core need scheduling to further improve on energy efficiency. This work proposes a solution based on queuing techniques for task scheduling based on complexity of the job.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Model of Networked College Students' Values Shaping based on Automatic Material Extraction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: It has become a daily habit for college students to communicate and obtain information through the Internet. This is due to the fact that this is a network environment with developed Internet technology and diverse ideological and cultural backgrounds. This paper proposes an automatic classification algorithm based on the automatic material extraction algorithm. The algorithm is designed based on the vector space model and the principle of position correlation, which improves the accuracy of the original vector space model algorithm. Taking the use of text materials as an example, this paper uses the SWOT analysis method to conduct an in-depth analysis of the advantages, disadvantages, external opportunities, and threats of the value shaping of networked college students.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Recognition and Analysis Framework of Japanese Katakana in the Background of Big Data and Fuzzy Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: With the increase of communication methods, more and more foreign words appear in Japanese communication. Since most of the syllables of these words do not conform to the cognitive schema and usage habits of Japanese katakana, the Japanese vocabulary system is not suitable for some words with more syllables. Vocabulary is abbreviated into katakana abbreviations and romaji abbreviations. The continuous template matching technology is used to analyze the distributed data structure of big data, the information fusion processing of cloud service combined big data is combined with the matching correlation detection method, and the frequent item detection and association rule feature extraction are performed on the high-dimensional fusion data. The method has a prediction accuracy of up to 7.3% and a small error of 6.2%.

articleTitle: Robust Construction of Intelligent Guidance System Based on Mobile Intelligent Multicast Terminal Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: An intelligent guidance system based on mobile intelligent multicast terminal algorithm is proposed. The multicast terminal algorithm divides all mobile terminals into robust sets or unicast scheduling sets, and adds redundant virtual links in the tree to reduce the number of nodes that cannot receive multicast packets. Simulation experiments show that adding redundant virtual links can greatly reduce the performance loss caused by node failure, up to 7.3%. And using the transmission characteristics of multicast data, the multicast scheduling set is sent in adjacent time slots of multicast data transmission. unicast data for all terminals in the unicast scheduling set, while for the terminals in the unicast scheduling set.

articleTitle: The Development of Ultrasonic C-Scan for Ferrous Wall Surface using the Climbing Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper describes the use of a wall-climbing robot for performing the ultrasonic C-Scan of the vertical surface. The robot utilizes permanent magnetic adhesion and can climb the ferrous surface to inspect the ferrous infrastructures like oil tanks. With the wheeled locomotion, encoders in the wheel can be used for locating the robot on the vertical surface. A specially designed housing is fabricated for the robot to hold a 2 MHz probe to perform the ultrasonic testing of the surface that is climbed. The probe holder movement is controlled through a motorized belt drive, enabling the probe to establish contact with the surface and retract. This paper details how the C-Scan is built using the position and A-Scan data thus obtained. Each scan data is processed individually using the MATLAB signal analyzer. It is evident from the results that the defect has a different frequency reflection and is visible from the C-Scan developed. The final C-Scan image was checked by superimposing on with the test surface and the defect was found to agree with the obtained scan image.

articleTitle: Calligraphy Digitization based on Node Sampling in Modeling of Cultural Communication Dynamic Network Span
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Digital information processing is essential in the recent time. This paper studies the calligraphy digitization based on the node sampling in modeling of cultural communication dynamic network span. The design dynamic model uses the CPU and GPU combined model because the dynamic network pruning algorithm will not reduce the actual scale of the network model and there will be no obvious reasoning acceleration when running on the GPU, it is necessary to design a specific hardware accelerator for the dynamic pruning algorithm and process some steps in the hardware according to the process details of the algorithm. Thus, the deep neural network using dynamic pruning algorithm can realize obvious reasoning acceleration on the mobile terminal. Further, the node sampling algorithm is integrated to the calligraphy digitization process. In the experiment, the performance of the visualized result has been shown.

articleTitle: Implementation of T-DET-FF using Predictive Power Control Circuit Model
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Pulsed Latches circuits are one of the important aspects in the reduction of power, for each read and write operations in memories. As the design complexity increases with improvement in technology, the design analysis on power and other performance factors in relation to the fundamental techniques encapsulated in Semiconductor gates. For improving the low power feature in memories, reduction of size of the transistor and its implementation with type of application is chosen. This paper has worked on the feature of power reduction by using a hybrid feature of T-DET-FF and its modelling with predictive power control (PPC) circuit and its design using transistor gates. The power and the transistor size in the proposed algorithm significantly improves the W/L ratio, that is used in different conditions for Pulsed latches for memory write and read operations. The simulated results with T-DET-FF are evaluated with Dynamic CMOS latch with PPC circuit using 32nm technology.

Author Keywords: MOSFET (Metal Oxide Semiconductor Field effect Transistor)

articleTitle: Multi Functional Synchronized Exciter and Down Converter for Surveillance Radar
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Design & Development of a Multi-functional RF subsystem consisting of multisource generator, up and down converter for Surveillance Radar operating in S Band is presented in this paper. This system generates synchronized clock, local oscillator signals along with transmitter and down converter function. Down converter is having channels for air target detection and weather prediction. System also generates test pulse for checking the entire Radar operation. Built in test operations, timing and controls for the system are communicated by Radar controller through the digital card present in this subsystem. System is designed and developed by meeting all the key requirements which is being used for Air traffic control radar systems.

articleTitle: Example Hardware Features that Support Information Security
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Security is a system-wide problem which must include software solutions for update capability and application flexibility. Software security is enhanced in both performance and security when supported by hardware features. This paper proposes hardware characteristics that support software security. These hardware security features are code agnostic and application independent. Example hardware features in the form of hardware components and secure instructions are described. Some example security enhancement implementation features are shown based on MIPS architecture.

articleTitle: Deep learning based Novel Vehicle Detection and Counting System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: When researchers talk about smart cities, management of traffic on the highway and road tracking of vehicles is very difficult but in the last few decades, technology has played a great role in solving this problem of traffic management on roads and highways. In this paper, we are going to discuss a similar kind of technology. This paper represents an identification technique based on VISION, which means tracking through cameras. It is mainly targeted at detecting vehicles, counting total number of vehicles, and detecting speed of every vehicle inside the frame.

articleTitle: Detection of Lung Inflammation using Chest X-ray with Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Lung Inflammation causes the passing of around 700,000 youngsters consistently and influences 7% of the worldwide populace. Chest X-ray images are principally utilized for the analysis of this infection. Notwithstanding, in any event, for a prepared radiologist, it is a moving errand to look at chest X-ray. There is a need to further develop the determination precision. In this work, an effective model is developed for the recognition of pneumonia from the computerized chest X-ray pictures is proposed. Several methods are utilized to expand the preparation of dataset in a decent manner. Consequently, it is more advantageous to fabricate a computerized indicator to anticipate the pneumonia utilizing the large information profound learning strategies. Among the wide range of various procedures, Convolutional Neural Networks stand tall and high in this forecast alongside different classifiers. Convolutional brain network comprising of convolution and pooling layers and completely associated Softmax layers toward the finish to give the last forecast.

articleTitle: System Integration and Data Center Analysis Algorithm of Network Guiding Innovation Platform Based on YIBAN Software
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: System integration and the data center analysis algorithm of network guiding innovation platform based on the YIBAN software is designed and implemented in the paper. The micro module computer room can integrate the infrastructure of the data center, that make it an efficient and also intelligent integrated computer room, and can effectively deal with fire fighting, monitoring and power supply. With this basic model, the center analysis is then put forwarded into the framework. Furthermore, the YIBAN system is integrated to implement the task, the network guiding smart scenario is constructed. The novel software is implemented to verify the designed system.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach to Gesture Recognition with Biometric Security
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Over the last few years, face and hand gesture recognition systems are applied in various applications similarly control systems, communications, human-computer interaction, and biometric-based security applications. Particularly, most of the innovations have been done for human-computer interaction using gesture recognition wherein non-verbal communication is a key research domain. However, it needs to be developed an appropriate method for non-verbal communication. In this research, a hybrid method is developed for creating more interactive nonverbal communication applications by combining facial and hand gesture recognition. Nonverbal communication applications that are interactive. The facial features are extracted using a support vector machine and a blaze palm can be implemented for gesture identification where the skin tone and palm detections are involved for better classification and formation of non-verbal communication. The proposed method is compared with recent existing methods, and it provides better results in terms of accuracy and more recognition capability.

articleTitle: URL Protection and Bookmark Hiding using AES Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In recent years, with the growing number of social networks and technologies, phishing has become a significant threat. Phishing is the fraudulent collection and exploitation of private data by the intended receivers. The phisher preys on internet users by duping them into disclosing the personal information in order to steal it and exploit fraudulently. This paper will be discussing and listing a few of the techniques that will help us to prevent the data from the cyber attackers. The paper concentrates on protecting URLs and hide bookmarks securely by using encryption and decryption techniques. This task is attained by the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm to encrypt and decrypt URLs for the authentication technique. Encryption is one of the most important and popular techniques to protect data from attackers using two vital processes namely encryption and decryption. When a user visits an encrypted URL, the user will be prompted for a password. A knocking sequence is used for the purpose of bookmark hiding. By using these methods, the users could progress towards preventing the data from such attacks.

Author Keywords: ASCII-American Standard Code for Information Interchange

articleTitle: Finger Knuckle Print Recognition using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Recent years have seen a surge in interest in biometric technologies. The finger-knuckle print (FKP) is one of the most common biometric characteristics. FKP would be a reliable and trustworthy biometric since the dorsal part of the finger is not accessible to exteriors. This article provides an FKP framework for extracting features from FKP images performed using Transfer Learning Convolutional Neural Networks Models. The proposed methodology is validated using the Hong Kong Polytechnic University’s publicly accessible PolyU FKP dataset. Experiment findings demonstrate that the suggested ResNet and SOFTMAX Classifiers attain an F1 Score of 98.9% when used together. According to the results, the suggested biometric identification system is secure, sturdy, and dependable.

articleTitle: Identification and Intelligent Analysis of Family Tragedies in Modern Dramas based on Information Extraction from Social Video Filters
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In modern dramas, there are many excellent drama works with family as the prototype and background. They focus on discussing the presentation of family conflicts in individual families in the big era and the changes in the relationship between family members. This article is based on the extraction of social video filter information. In modern tragedies, the spatial thinking of dialogue drama scenes is extended, and the identification and intelligent analysis of spatial dimensions and dramatic conflict settings are explored from four aspects: regional space, political space, psychological space and room. This paper analyzes the feature extraction of social video information from the dimensions of social demand, communication subject, and communication content, and proposes to create an excellent video viewing environment to meet the needs of the audience and promote social video to achieve better communication effects.

articleTitle: Ruby Programming Implementation of Multi-Dimensional Platform for Tax Talent Training in "Internet +" Financial Information System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Combining the growth characteristics and psychological characteristics of high-level compound tax talents, on the basis of summarizing the status quo of the construction of tax informatization system, based on the basic theory of ecosystem, and based on "Internet+", the connotation structure, The current situation and existing problems are analyzed and researched. First, the multi-dimensional platform architecture of tax talent training in the financial information system is briefly introduced and analyzed from the three aspects of Ruby language, MVC architecture process and agile development, and then the automated test case management call Detailed requirements analysis and design of the system.

articleTitle: Modelling of Piezoelectric Harvesting System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The development of the idea behind the paper deals with the need of using piezoelectric materials to produce energy by harvesting it from the vibration or footstep. Nowadays, harvested power from the encircling surroundings performs a vital function in human life. A piezoelectric power harvesting machine consists of sections: a transducer to transform ability power to electric power and an electrical interface to control this power. Piezoelectric substances may be used to transform oscillatory mechanical power into electric power. This technology, collectively with modern mechanical coupling designs, can shape the premise for harvesting power from mechanical movement. Piezoelectric power may be harvested to transform on-vibration movement from the human frame into electric energy.

articleTitle: Dynamic Evolution Model of Sustainable Development of Sports Towns in Liaoning Province based on Real-time Remote Sensing Image Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Dynamic evolution model of the sustainable development of sports towns in Liaoning Province based on real-time remote sensing image classification algorithm is presented in the paper. The development of space microwave remote sensing technology has made great progress, the measurement accuracy of detection elements has been continuously improved, various new concepts, new technologies and new systems to meet specific needs have been emerging, and also related technologies have gradually made breakthroughs. With this background, this paper designs the novel real-time remote sensing image classification algorithm. The basic principle is to classify the observed pixel into the category with the highest probability by calculating the probability of the observed pixel relative to each category. For the real-time feature, the evolution model is combined. The designed model ius applied to the estimation of the sustainable development of sports towns in Liaoning Province.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning based on Covid-19 Classification using CT Scan Image
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Initially, the coronavirus infection has been diagnosed by using the Chest CT scan and x-ray images of the patients. An accurate representation of the victim’s respiratory system allows the medical practitioners to detect the covid-19 infection. The first step of the proposed approach is to preprocess the image in order to eliminate any undesirable noise that may be present in medical images. Following that, the intended features are retrieved from a processed image. Finally, Transfer Learning is used to categorize the data. The CT scan based representations are separated by using a U-net simulation, and the split representation is then used to train and analyze the data by using the v3 simulator, which helps to differentiate the coronavirus infection and pneumonia infection and securely protect the resulting documents.

articleTitle: Covid Prevention System for Face Mask Detection and Temperature Sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Currently, the world is experiencing a serious medical crisis as a result of the Corona virus COVID-19, which now has swept the globe. For several countries, combating this disease outbreak has become an unfortunate reality. Wearing a face mask when going outside or meeting with others is essential for prevention. Some irresponsible people, on the other hand, refuse to wear face masks for a variety of reasons. The development of the face mask detector too is critical in this case. To address this problem, a reliable face mask detector must be created. A face mask can be detected using the object detection algorithm. The mask detection algorithm used to detect the face mask was Haar Cascade in OpenCV from Python. According to the results of the experiments, this device can detect whether or not someone is wearing a face mask and can also measure body temperature. Once these validations are completed automatically door gets opened and sanitization is done.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning Approach for 6G-IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) have shown a significant role in attaining higher accuracy and precision for real-time Internet of Things (IoT) applications. On the other hand, to obtain a higher throughput in IoT domains viz., Vehicular Communication (VC), Unmanned-Aerial Vehicles (UAV), and Healthcare-IoT (HIoT), it is required to train the AI/ML models with an ample amount of data. Due to security reasons, it is becoming difficult to connect the devices over different networks. Also, the unavailability of data sharing due to company policies has restricted the data usage over other networks. This paper describes the emergence of transfer learning techniques for future 6G-IoT applications which reduce the time taken for retraining these models.

articleTitle: Keller: Indian Sign Language based Gesture to Text and Speech Assistant for Covid-19 Protective Quotes
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Communication promotes the flow of information between the people of different cultures present all over the world. As a result, it is critical that whatever one wishes to communicate with another is readily comprehended. The world is a place for people with a variety of abilities not just cultural differences. Differently abled people, who are unable to orally convey their thoughts and ideas find it challenging to communicate. This communication barrier has resulted in lack of self-development and social inequity among people with disabilities, especially the deaf-mute population. This article focuses on bridging this communication gap using a sensor-based, user-friendly, real-time solution based on Indian Sign Language (ISL) gestures. Furthermore New Education Policy, July 2020 has standardized Indian Sign Language (ISL) as a common language to interact, understand and simplify day to day communication for deaf-dumb community. The proposed method primarily focuses on ISL gestures, which are used to communicate about the current covid-19 pandemic situation and necessary precautions to combat the further spread of the covid19 infection.

articleTitle: Fusion of Digital Physical Fitness Training with Infrared Heat Map Image Segmentation and Motion Tracking in Badminton
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Fusion of the digital physical fitness training with infrared heat map segmentation and motion tracking in the badminton is studied in the paper. From the random finite set model of the measurement, it is observed that the order of each measurement element in the measurement set is irrelevant, and both the cardinality of the measurement set and the position of the elements in the measurement set are random. In the special analysis, the infrared heat map image segmentation and motion tracking in the badminton will be considered. In order to solve the inaccuracy of the existing global mapping methods for the recognition of infrared image background and target. With these combinations, this paper gives the novel framework. Theough the application testing, the performance is validated.

articleTitle: Analysis of Microstrip Fractal Antenna with Multiband Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The role of an antenna is crucial in the wireless communication process as it allows the transmission of information among the devices. Due to the advancement of technology, there is a demand for miniaturized antenna. The traditional micro strip antenna may be of any form like square, rectangular, triangle and so on. Normally, those antennas offer unmarried resonance frequency with High Quality Factor because of its slim bandwidth. However, the Fractal antennas are capable of offers both multi-band resonances and huge bandwidth due to the self-comparable and space-filling properties. These are commonly used for various wireless communication such as WLAN, Wi-Fi and Wi-Max devices.

articleTitle: Design of Elliptical Slot Reconfigurable Patch Antenna with RF MEMS Switch for Biomedical Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this work a frequency reconfigurable antenna integrated with RF MEMS switch is presented for biomedical applications. The frequency reconfiguration is analysed and validated by studying various parameters. The switch reconfiguration is addressed for the proposed reconfigurable antenna design. The proposed reconfigurable elliptical shaped patch (RESP) antenna with split ring resonator is resonated at 4.6GHZ frequency with a reflection coefficient of -21dB in ON state while in OFF state the antenna works at 4.8GHZ frequency with return loss of -26dB respectively. Also, the proposed antenna achieves frequency reconfiguration from 4.6GHz to 4.8GHZ. The simulated radiation patterns along with current fields are also presented. The gain is observed nearly greater that 5dB at respective operating frequencies. The proposed reconfigurable antenna is applicable for biomedical applications.

Author Keywords: Radio frequency microelectro mechanical system switch

articleTitle: Controller Design with Dead Time Compensation for Distillation Column
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The distillation columns are widely used in various chemical industries. It is basically used for separating the components of a liquid mixture. The More volatile component is vaporized, and the less volatile one is left back in the liquid. The plant of distillation column that is considered in the present work is a SOPDT transfer function model imported from an online source. Due to the impact of present dead time, the stability in the output variable is a challenging task. So, the improved control performance is achieved by the dead time compensation using the Smith predictor. The PI control systems are designed, using MATLAB, for this plant with and without Smith predictor, and their performance is compared.

articleTitle: Overlay Implementation for Video Display
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: An overlay is typically something like the other information about the upcoming program and other social information whilst the video is being played on the television. The main aim of this research work is to display the overlay text, overlay audio bars, and overlay graphs along with the decoder output when the video is being decoded. In decoders, the transpose stream will be sent through ASI output, and the decoder will decode the compressed data and display it through SDI output. In addition to the decoder output, text format, and audio bars, a graph will be displayed along with the data extracted from the compressed data stream. Model Sim Tool is used to create a standalone setup for simulation and generate a YUV file for visualizing the results. The existing methods will only display the format and frame rate. Additionally, the proposed method displays few other parameters such as transmitter information, modulation technique, PID information of the projected video, gain calculations in audio, and graph display, in addition to the format and frame rate, which is considered as a significant research improvement.

articleTitle: Tongue Print Image Recognition and Authentication using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In recent years, tongue print identification has been a hot research topic in biometric applications. The tongue is a critical internal organ that is well-protected from the outside world by the oral cavity. Not only tongue print a cutting-edge biometric technique, but it is also a very effective forensic tool. This article provides a Tongue Print recognition framework for extracting features from tongue images performed using Convolutional Neural Networks Models. The proposed methodology is validated using our own database. Experiment findings demonstrate that the suggested VGG16 attains an F1 Score of 98.9%. According to the results, the suggested biometric identification system is secure, sturdy, and dependable.

articleTitle: System Identification and Control System Design for Bioreactor Process
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A control system can’t be simulated using the conventional tuning methods without the availability of mathematical model of the plant being controlled. The work done in this paper is grounded on the available raw data pertaining to an industrial biochemical reactor process. Using this data, multiple mathematical models of the plant are identified in MATLAB using system identification toolbox. The fittest model is chosen for control system designing. For this model, CHR and IMC based controllers are designed in MATLAB. Their set-point and disturbance responses are analyzed.

articleTitle: Product Reviews on Opinion Mining using NLP Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Opinion mining is a natural language processing (NLP) based automated text analysis to identify emotions and opinions (positive and negative comments) present in a text. Opinion mining is the technique used for automatically gathering knowledge from different user opinions on a certain topic or situation. The amount of data available on the internet is growing at a high rate. Every day, social media generates a massive quantity of data, such as reviews, comments, and customer feedback. This huge volume of user-generated data is unintelligible unless specific mining techniques are applied to it. Since there are so many fake reviews, there is a need for the opinion mining approach to integrate a spam detection module to deliver a legitimate opinion. People nowadays rely on social media opinions to decide whichever products or services to purchase. Since there are numerous bogus or fraudulent reviews issued by organizations or individuals for a number of reasons, spam detection will emerge as a complex and time-consuming task. The proposed system includes ontology, geolocation and IP address monitoring, a lexicon of spam phrases using naive bayes, comment detection, and account tracking.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Solar Energy-Supported Standalone Electric Vehicle Charging Point/Panel using MVO Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Battery-powered car manufacturing and use are already advancing rapidly. This produces zero pollutants, seems to be very efficient, produces little disturbance, and requires minimal servicing. The charging points, which are necessary to charge the autonomous car battery packs, nevertheless, place tremendous power requirements just on the power system. Using renewable energy sources like solar technology becomes a solution to overcome power system stress. Furthermore, freestanding charging points are beneficial to the electric grid. Nonetheless, the design and installation among those networks employ a variety of methodologies and maybe somewhat complicated at points. This research presents a novel, straightforward planning and optimization of a photo voltaic-powered standalone charging point/panel. The system is therefore modelled and simulated with the Matlab Simulink environment. In addition, the instrumentation is created that experimentally test the technology. The suggested system's analytical and modelling outcomes are presented to the parametric study. The study demonstrates that for all Photovoltaic irradiance disruptions, the charging time of the EV battery remains perfectly stable. Furthermore, the battery management of an electric battery system adapts flawlessly to collect and balance changes in Photovoltaic panels.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Package Query Processing System using Parallel Processing Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: General set-based inquiries pose several challenges in query processing systems in terms of time and space complexity. Most E-commerce platforms attract clients by offering smart chatbots. These systems use package inquiries, coupled with Artificial Intelligence [AI] systems to propose items that are more appealing to buyers, and they also collect people’s characteristics and preferences to match the replies more accurately. This research study has surveyed different package query systems developed by other researchers and found that the usage of Big Data tools help to store and map huge amount of data and it also helps them to retrieve the data as early as possible. It also found that the implementation of genetic based soft computing algorithms to reduce time complexity and answer the user query. The implementation of machine learning algorithm enhances the pre-processing and feature engineering procedures involved in the proposed research work.

articleTitle: Automated Adaptive IR based Traffic Control
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The issue of traffic congestion and regulation has become a big worry in today’s globe. It is not limited to megacities or metropolitan areas, but also to small towns. As a result, a sensible or intelligent traffic management system is required. The proposed current control system isn’t adaptive; instead, it is timing based and is unaffected by traffic density. Because of the system’s nature is static, it is inefficient, chaotic, and loud. A real-time information gathering of the traffic and monitoring system is presented to address this issue of road management of traffic. The suggested model is a function of real-time traffic density and in a sequential manner the regulation for clearing time of every lane is given. The method is very hybrid, consisting of a combination of sensor networks. When compared to native approach IoT ensures the results which are more accurate and efficient. RFID technology is additionally achieved for emergency vehicles besides prioritization and minimization for vehicles. The model which is used can predict traffic status and also traffic jams at different times, this can also be used for purpose of analysis. In time smart system this proposed model is cost-effective and efficient in time.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality (Hologram) based Food Supply System in Smart Restaurant based Menu Ordering System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The realm of technology is supposed to be the era of today. As a way to enhance the dining experience, restaurant owners have made considerable investments in information and communication technologies such as PDAs, wireless LANs, and high-end multi-touch monitors. In this article, a hologram-based menu card is proposed as a way to revolutionise the patron’s experience. This structure delivers a menu card indigital form that will suggest foods. Table-side gadgets display the menu, which is available to all customers. The kitchen will be notified after the clients have selected their preferred meal. The device will be installed in the client area, same as it is in the kitchen. The dishes are then saved in a cloud storage system for future reference. Because it only requires the purchase of a single device, this technology is less costly than earlier automated meal ordering systems.

articleTitle: Design of an Intelligent Dynamic Monitoring Platform for the Impact of Venture Capital Network Community Structure Characteristics Data Mining on Investment Performance
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Design of an intelligent dynamic monitoring platform for the impact of venture capital network community structure characteristics data mining on investment performance is studied in the paper. To a certain extent, the spatial organization of cross-regional and cross-investment presented by Chinese venture capital also shows the weakening trend of the original center level model. Hence, the network community structure characteristics data mining is integrated. To establish the multi-source data signal sensor, this research work will first analyze the structure of the multi-source data signal sensor, design the data flow interface according to the performance requirements of the system for signal sensing and the sensor architecture, design the sensor structure through the data flow structure, divide the framework of data intelligent analysis. In order to further mine the characteristic words of general tourism theme, this paper adopts the vector space model to realize the conversion of text features to vectors and then, the simulation is conducted to test the performance under different models.

articleTitle: Intelligent Recognition of Intertextual Artistic Conception in Ancient Poetry and Literature based on PSO-SVM Algorithm and its Extended Scene Modeling of Culture and Art
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper focuses on 3 main studies. (1) The novel PSO-SVM algorithm is designed as the theoretical basis. Support vector machines based on statistical learning theory can solve classification problems well. It is known for solving small sample size and non-linear problems; hence, the PSO is integrated to improve the robustness of the traditional SVM. (2) Scene modelling is considered. The production of three-dimensional model directly affects the performance of the modeling effect, and the 3Dmax model is used to achieve the comprehensive of the model. (3) Intelligent recognition of the intertextual artistic conception is conducted. The novel text recognition algorithm is defined to perform better. Through the testing on the different datasets, the accuracy and efficiency are both tested with the robustness estimation.

articleTitle: Multi-platform Online Broadcasting System of College English Innovation based on API Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Multi-platform online broadcasting system of college English innovation based on API optimization algorithm is designed and implemented in the paper. Evidence theory uses the probability interval to replace the uncertain data with a core certain fixed probability value, so that the problem of representing uncertainty can be solved. Evidence theory can accurately distinguish unknowing from uncertainty, improving conflict by using probabilities common to all target sets. Hence, the designed framework is based on this the ory. With this general consideration, the multi-platform online broadcasting system should be integrated. The cross-platform and portability of the Java can be well adapted to the multi-platform situation of the railway information sources. Designed framework is applied to the broadcasting system of college English innovation based on API optimization. Through the testing, the system is proven to be efficient.

articleTitle: Online and Offline Channel Data Integration of Internet Smart Retail Under the Background of Parallel Blockchain Algorithm and Computational Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Online and offline channel data integration of Internet smart retail under the background of the parallel blockchain algorithm and computational intelligence is studied in the paper. Blockchain technology can improve the efficiency and security of digital copyright registration and reduce the cost of registration. Based on the openness and transparency of the blockchain, the public can understand the rights of the digital copyright through the blockchain. The transmission of the blockchain technology information adopts general asymmetric encryption technology. Asymmetric encryption means that the same key is not used for encryption and decryption. It is usually two keys, which are called “public key” and “private key” respectively. The two keys must be used in pairs, otherwise the encrypted file cannot be opened. With these tools, the O2O channel data integration of Internet smart retail is implemented.

articleTitle: Automated Data Management for HealthCare using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In the modern world, day-to-day life has become easier with help of technology. There is a lot of problem with carrying and managing medical reports when coming to health checkup, so to tackle that problem we have come with the solution of developing an android application. For storing all the reports and prescription google firebase is being used. Initial authentication for patients and doctors will be different. A unique id will be given to each doctor and hospital. Patients will register using a government id and mobile number. The medical history will be only accessible to the doctor and user. Using a QR code scanner, a doctor can access the patient's medical history by scanning the patient's QR code. The doctor uploads all the medical scanned reports of the patient in pdf form and jpeg form. The is stored in cloud so it can be accessible via internet anywhere.

articleTitle: Reconstruct of Paths in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The latest wireless sensor network (WSNs) had become more advanced as range of networking is increasing This paper proposes a routing approach that is I Path, a unique path interpreting approach for constructing the paths. The main aim of I Path is to improve the large path equality to iteration include the large path against small paths. At first, it begins with the initial paths and performs Routh interpreting step by step. It includes a novel structure using a light-weight hash value to verify a complete route for the development for deciphering capacity due to execution potency, I Path involves a quick bootstrapping formula for the reconstruct of initial nodes. It also included that if any user tries to access a file without giving a secret key that the user will be blocked unless the admin unblocked him. As the results show that I Path success in achieving much better reconstruction rates under the different network conditions compared to any other approaches and also more secure.
